我要做一个高校毕业设计指导预约与评语版本系统。学生和导师在这里安排约谈、提交稿件并跟进修改，双方需要能查清每次指导针对的是哪一版内容。

学生先选导师时段，上传稿件和准备讨论的问题。导师在约谈后针对该版本留下修改意见，学生交新稿时逐条回应，旧稿、附件和评语都要保留。学生首页突出尚未处理的意见，导师首页按预约时间和提交截止日安排待办。

同一时段只能由一名学生预约，导师请假后要释放相应时段。误传稿件允许撤回，但已经引用它的指导记录不能被改掉。学生无权替导师关闭意见，答辩资格必须由导师根据最终稿及未解决的问题确认，同时防止其他导师访问无权查看的资料。

技术上采用 PHP、Laravel 和 Eloquent，数据库使用 SQLite，前端用 React。通知在本地模拟，附件保存在本地目录，整个项目用一条命令启动。请用示例验证预约冲突、稿件与评语的版本追溯，以及跨导师访问权限。

addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

The user wants to build a graduation thesis guidance appointment and review versioning system. 

The full-stack project tech stack has been finalized, with core functions like appointment conflict detection and version permission management verified. Environment dependencies including PHP, Composer, Node.js and npm will be checked first, and the task will be completed methodically with a todo list.

Core domain rules covering user roles, appointment and version management, permission specifications and notification mechanisms have been clarified, and the one-click startup solution for the project has also been finalized.

I've finalized the static build-based one-click startup solution, with an extra Vite dev server option for development convenience. I'll first check tool availability, then design the data model, and have added the advisor_id field to the user table.

It has been decided that students will only be able to book slots for their assigned advisors to simplify authorization. A unique constraint will be added to the appointments table to prevent double booking, with transaction locking used during booking checks.

It has been confirmed that SQLite does not support row locks, so transaction wrapping plus status rechecking and the unique index on the appointments table are sufficient to guarantee booking security. It has also been clarified that when a advisor is on leave, open slots in the relevant period will be released directly, and booked slots will be cancelled with the student notified.

I've finished designing the core data structures, including the appointments table and submissions table, and clarified the design logic for manuscript version management.

I've finalized the design logic for manuscript comment systems, guidance records and defense qualification management, and confirmed the notification system will use a database + polling implementation with local logging.

File storage and access specifications have been clarified, cross-advisor authorization checks will be enforced for all operations, a lightweight Vite + React SPA will be built without heavy UI libraries, and Laravel Sanctum with built-in session CSRF support will be used for authentication.

I'll manually create the Laravel project to avoid network issues during installation. I've confirmed the test plan: seed 2 advisors and 2 pre-assigned students, plus test cases covering double booking, version trace, and cross-advisor access restrictions, to be verified via PHPUnit feature tests and a demo script.

I will include test coverage and a seeded demo walkthrough in the README, and run all pre-defined test cases after finishing development. I've sorted out 10 sequential implementation steps, and will start by checking the runtime environment.

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Database\Factories\UserFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Hidden;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;
use Laravel\Sanctum\HasApiTokens;

#[Fillable(['name', 'email', 'password', 'role', 'student_no', 'title'])]
#[Hidden(['password', 'remember_token'])]
class User extends Authenticatable
{
    /** @use HasFactory<UserFactory> */
    use HasApiTokens, HasFactory, Notifiable;

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'email_verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'password' => 'hashed',
        ];
    }

    public function isStudent(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === 'student';
    }

    public function isAdvisor(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === 'advisor';
    }

    /** 学生发起的课题 */
    public function projects(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Project::class, 'student_id');
    }

    /** 导师指导的课题 */
    public function advisedProjects(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Project::class, 'advisor_id');
    }

    public function slots(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(AdvisorSlot::class, 'advisor_id');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class Project extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = [
        'title', 'description', 'student_id', 'advisor_id',
        'deadline_at', 'defense_eligible', 'eligibility_note', 'eligibility_decided_at',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'deadline_at' => 'datetime',
            'defense_eligible' => 'boolean',
            'eligibility_decided_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    public function student(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'student_id');
    }

    public function advisor(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'advisor_id');
    }

    public function manuscriptVersions(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(ManuscriptVersion::class)->orderBy('version_no');
    }

    public function bookings(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Booking::class);
    }

    public function guidanceRecords(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(GuidanceRecord::class);
    }

    protected function latestVersion(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn () => $this->manuscriptVersions()->orderByDesc('version_no')->first());
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphMany;

class ManuscriptVersion extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = [
        'project_id', 'student_id', 'booking_id', 'version_no',
        'title', 'note', 'status', 'withdrawn_at', 'withdraw_reason', 'is_final',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'withdrawn_at' => 'datetime',
            'is_final' => 'boolean',
        ];
    }

    public function project(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
    }

    public function student(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'student_id');
    }

    public function booking(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Booking::class);
    }

    public function attachments(): MorphMany
    {
        return $this->morphMany(Attachment::class, 'attachable');
    }

    public function guidanceRecords(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(GuidanceRecord::class);
    }

    public function responses(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(CommentResponse::class);
    }

    public function isActive(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === 'active';
    }

    public function isWithdrawn(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === 'withdrawn';
    }

    /** 是否允许撤回：尚未被任何指导记录引用才可撤回 */
    public function canWithdraw(): bool
    {
        return $this->isActive() && !$this->guidanceRecords()->exists();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphMany;

/**
 * 指导记录：导师约谈后针对某一稿件版本创建。
 * 一经创建不可编辑、不可删除（控制器层不提供 update/destroy）。
 * 即使所引用的稿件被撤回，记录及其评语仍原样保留并继续指向该版本。
 */
class GuidanceRecord extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = [
        'project_id', 'booking_id', 'advisor_id', 'manuscript_version_id', 'summary',
    ];

    public function project(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
    }

    public function booking(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Booking::class);
    }

    public function advisor(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'advisor_id');
    }

    public function manuscriptVersion(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(ManuscriptVersion::class);
    }

    public function comments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Comment::class);
    }

    public function attachments(): MorphMany
    {
        return $this->morphMany(Attachment::class, 'attachable');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class Comment extends Model
{
    public const STATUS_OPEN = 'open';
    public const STATUS_RESOLVED = 'resolved'; // 学生已回应，待导师确认
    public const STATUS_CLOSED = 'closed';     // 导师确认关闭

    protected $fillable = [
        'guidance_record_id', 'advisor_id', 'content', 'status', 'closed_by', 'closed_at',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'closed_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    public function guidanceRecord(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(GuidanceRecord::class);
    }

    public function advisor(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'advisor_id');
    }

    public function responses(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(CommentResponse::class)->orderBy('created_at');
    }

    public function closedBy(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'closed_by');
    }

    public function isOpen(): bool
    {
        return $this->status !== self::STATUS_CLOSED;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\AppNotification;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

/**
 * 本地模拟通知：落库（前端轮询 /api/notifications），
 * 同时追加写入 storage/logs/notifications.log，模拟“推送到用户”。
 */
class NotificationService
{
    public function send(User $user, string $type, string $title, ?string $body = null, array $data = []): AppNotification
    {
        $notification = AppNotification::create([
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'type' => $type,
            'title' => $title,
            'body' => $body,
            'data' => $data,
        ]);

        $line = sprintf(
            "[%s] -> 用户#%d(%s) [%s] %s%s",
            now()->toDateTimeString(),
            $user->id,
            $user->name,
            $type,
            $title,
            $body ? " | {$body}" : '',
        );

        // 模拟外部推送通道（本地仅写日志文件）
        Log::build([
            'driver' => 'single',
            'path' => Storage::path('logs/notifications.log'),
        ])->info($line, $data);

        return $notification;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class BookingService
{
    public function __construct(private NotificationService $notifications)
    {
    }

    /**
     * 学生预约导师时段。
     *
     * 冲突防护有两层：
     *  1. 事务内再次读取并校验 slot.status = open；
     *  2. bookings.slot_id 上的“部分唯一索引”（WHERE status='booked'）兜底并发写入。
     */
    public function book(AdvisorSlot $slot, User $student, ?Project $project, ?string $questions): Booking
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($slot, $student, $project, $questions) {
            /** @var AdvisorSlot $lockedSlot */
            $lockedSlot = AdvisorSlot::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($slot->id);

            if ($lockedSlot->status !== AdvisorSlot::statuses()['open']) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'slot_id' => '该时段已被预约或不可预约，请选择其他时段。',
                ])->status(409);
            }

            if ($lockedSlot->start_at->isPast()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'slot_id' => '该时段已开始，无法预约。',
                ])->status(422);
            }

            if ($project && $project->student_id !== $student->id) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'project_id' => '只能为自己的课题发起预约。',
                ])->status(403);
            }

            try {
                $booking = Booking::create([
                    'slot_id' => $lockedSlot->id,
                    'student_id' => $student->id,
                    'project_id' => $project?->id,
                    'questions' => $questions,
                    'status' => 'booked',
                ]);
            } catch (QueryException $e) {
                // 唯一索引冲突（SQLite SQLSTATE 23000）
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'slot_id' => '该时段刚刚被其他学生预约，请选择其他时段。',
                ])->status(409);
            }

            $lockedSlot->update(['status' => 'booked']);

            $this->notifications->send(
                $lockedSlot->advisor,
                'booking_created',
                '新的约谈预约',
                sprintf('%s 预约了 %s 的时段', $student->name, $lockedSlot->start_at->toDateTimeString()),
                ['booking_id' => $booking->id, 'slot_id' => $lockedSlot->id],
            );

            return $booking->load(['slot', 'student', 'project']);
        });
    }

    /** 学生主动取消：时段重新开放给其他学生 */
    public function cancelByStudent(Booking $booking): Booking
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($booking) {
            /** @var Booking $fresh */
            $fresh = Booking::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($booking->id);

            if ($fresh->status !== 'booked') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['booking' => '该预约已不可取消。'])->status(422);
            }

            $fresh->update(['status' => 'cancelled', 'cancelled_at' => now()]);
            $fresh->slot->update(['status' => 'open']);

            $this->notifications->send(
                $fresh->slot->advisor,
                'booking_cancelled',
                '学生取消了预约',
                sprintf('%s 取消了 %s 的时段', $fresh->student->name, $fresh->slot->start_at->toDateTimeString()),
                ['booking_id' => $fresh->id],
            );

            return $fresh;
        });
    }

    /**
     * 导师请假：该时段释放。
     * 若已有学生预约，预约取消并通知学生改约。
     */
    public function advisorLeave(AdvisorSlot $slot, ?string $reason = null): AdvisorSlot
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($slot, $reason) {
            /** @var AdvisorSlot $fresh */
            $fresh = AdvisorSlot::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($slot->id);

            $booking = $fresh->booking()->where('status', 'booked')->first();

            if ($booking) {
                $booking->update(['status' => 'cancelled', 'cancelled_at' => now()]);

                $this->notifications->send(
                    $booking->student,
                    'slot_released_leave',
                    '导师请假，预约时段已释放',
                    sprintf(
                        '您预约的 %s 时段因导师请假%s已取消，请重新选择时段。',
                        $fresh->start_at->toDateTimeString(),
                        $reason ? "（{$reason}）" : '',
                    ),
                    ['slot_id' => $fresh->id, 'booking_id' => $booking->id],
                );
            }

            // leave = 导师请假占位，不再对外开放
            $fresh->update(['status' => 'leave']);

            return $fresh;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class BookingService
{
    public function __construct(private NotificationService $notifications)
    {
    }

    /**
     * 学生预约导师时段。
     *
     * 冲突防护有两层：
     *  1. 事务内再次读取并校验 slot.status = open；
     *  2. bookings.slot_id 上的“部分唯一索引”（WHERE status='booked'）兜底并发写入。
     */
    public function book(AdvisorSlot $slot, User $student, ?Project $project, ?string $questions): Booking
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($slot, $student, $project, $questions) {
            /** @var AdvisorSlot $lockedSlot */
            $lockedSlot = AdvisorSlot::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($slot->id);

            if ($lockedSlot->status !== AdvisorSlot::statuses()['open']) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'slot_id' => '该时段已被预约或不可预约，请选择其他时段。',
                ])->status(409);
            }

            if ($lockedSlot->start_at->isPast()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'slot_id' => '该时段已开始，无法预约。',
                ])->status(422);
            }

            if ($project && $project->student_id !== $student->id) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'project_id' => '只能为自己的课题发起预约。',
                ])->status(403);
            }

            try {
                $booking = Booking::create([
                    'slot_id' => $lockedSlot->id,
                    'student_id' => $student->id,
                    'project_id' => $project?->id,
                    'questions' => $questions,
                    'status' => 'booked',
                ]);
            } catch (QueryException $e) {
                // 唯一索引冲突（SQLite SQLSTATE 23000）
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'slot_id' => '该时段刚刚被其他学生预约，请选择其他时段。',
                ])->status(409);
            }

            $lockedSlot->update(['status' => 'booked']);

            $this->notifications->send(
                $lockedSlot->advisor,
                'booking_created',
                '新的约谈预约',
                sprintf('%s 预约了 %s 的时段', $student->name, $lockedSlot->start_at->toDateTimeString()),
                ['booking_id' => $booking->id, 'slot_id' => $lockedSlot->id],
            );

            return $booking->load(['slot', 'student', 'project']);
        });
    }

    /** 学生主动取消：时段重新开放给其他学生 */
    public function cancelByStudent(Booking $booking): Booking
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($booking) {
            /** @var Booking $fresh */
            $fresh = Booking::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($booking->id);

            if ($fresh->status !== 'booked') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['booking' => '该预约已不可取消。'])->status(422);
            }

            $fresh->update(['status' => 'cancelled', 'cancelled_at' => now()]);
            $fresh->slot->update(['status' => 'open']);

            $this->notifications->send(
                $fresh->slot->advisor,
                'booking_cancelled',
                '学生取消了预约',
                sprintf('%s 取消了 %s 的时段', $fresh->student->name, $fresh->slot->start_at->toDateTimeString()),
                ['booking_id' => $fresh->id],
            );

            return $fresh;
        });
    }

    /**
     * 导师请假：该时段释放。
     * 若已有学生预约，预约取消并通知学生改约。
     */
    public function advisorLeave(AdvisorSlot $slot, ?string $reason = null): AdvisorSlot
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($slot, $reason) {
            /** @var AdvisorSlot $fresh */
            $fresh = AdvisorSlot::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($slot->id);

            $booking = $fresh->booking()->where('status', 'booked')->first();

            if ($booking) {
                $booking->update(['status' => 'cancelled', 'cancelled_at' => now()]);

                $this->notifications->send(
                    $booking->student,
                    'slot_released_leave',
                    '导师请假，预约时段已释放',
                    sprintf(
                        '您预约的 %s 时段因导师请假%s已取消，请重新选择时段。',
                        $fresh->start_at->toDateTimeString(),
                        $reason ? "（{$reason}）" : '',
                    ),
                    ['slot_id' => $fresh->id, 'booking_id' => $booking->id],
                );
            }

            // leave = 导师请假占位，不再对外开放
            $fresh->update(['status' => 'leave']);

            return $fresh;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Comment;
use App\Models\GuidanceRecord;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class ManuscriptService
{
    public function __construct(private NotificationService $notifications)
    {
    }

    /**
     * 学生提交新稿件版本。
     * - 版本号在课题内自增，旧版本永远保留；
     * - 可携带对导师评语的逐条回应（回应绑定到新版本，便于追溯“在哪一版改的”）；
     * - 被回应的评语进入 resolved（待导师确认），学生不能直接关闭。
     *
     * @param  array<int, array{comment_id:int,content:string}>  $responses
     * @param  array<int, UploadedFile>  $files
     */
    public function submitVersion(
        Project $project,
        User $student,
        string $title,
        ?string $note,
        array $files,
        array $responses = [],
        ?Booking $booking = null,
        bool $isFinal = false,
    ): ManuscriptVersion {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($project, $student, $title, $note, $files, $responses, $booking, $isFinal) {
            $versionNo = (int) $project->manuscriptVersions()->withTrashed()->max('version_no') + 1;

            // 用显式聚合而非仅 ORM，避免 withdrawn 行影响取号
            $versionNo = (int) DB::table('manuscript_versions')->where('project_id', $project->id)->max('version_no') + 1;

            if ($isFinal) {
                // 同一课题同时只有一个最终稿标记
                DB::table('manuscript_versions')->where('project_id', $project->id)->update(['is_final' => false]);
            }

            $version = ManuscriptVersion::create([
                'project_id' => $project->id,
                'student_id' => $student->id,
                'booking_id' => $booking?->id,
                'version_no' => $versionNo,
                'title' => $title,
                'note' => $note,
                'status' => 'active',
                'is_final' => $isFinal,
            ]);

            $this->storeAttachments($version, $files, $student);

            foreach ($responses as $response) {
                $comment = Comment::query()
                    ->whereHas('guidanceRecord', fn ($q) => $q->where('project_id', $project->id))
                    ->find($response['comment_id']);

                if (!$comment) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'responses' => "评语 #{$response['comment_id']} 不属于本课题，无法回应。",
                    ])->status(422);
                }

                if ($comment->status === Comment::STATUS_CLOSED) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'responses' => "评语 #{$comment->id} 已由导师关闭，不能再回应。",
                    ])->status(422);
                }

                $version->responses()->create([
                    'comment_id' => $comment->id,
                    'student_id' => $student->id,
                    'content' => $response['content'],
                ]);

                $comment->update(['status' => Comment::STATUS_RESOLVED]);
            }

            if ($project->advisor) {
                $this->notifications->send(
                    $project->advisor,
                    'manuscript_submitted',
                    "收到新稿件（v{$versionNo}）",
                    sprintf('%s 提交了《%s》第 %d 版', $student->name, $title, $versionNo),
                    ['project_id' => $project->id, 'version_id' => $version->id],
                );
            }

            return $version->load(['attachments', 'responses']);
        });
    }

    /**
     * 学生撤回误传稿件。
     * 仅当没有任何指导记录引用该版本时允许；一旦已被引用，记录不可改动、稿件不可撤回。
     */
    public function withdrawVersion(ManuscriptVersion $mVersion, string $reason): ManuscriptVersion
    {
        if (!$mVersion->canWithdraw()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'version' => '该版本已被指导记录引用，不能撤回（历史指导证据必须保留）。',
            ])->status(422);
        }

        $mVersion->update([
            'status' => 'withdrawn',
            'withdrawn_at' => now(),
            'withdraw_reason' => $reason,
        ]);

        return $mVersion;
    }

    /**
     * 导师在约谈后针对某一版本创建指导记录（含多条评语与附件）。
     * 记录一经创建即不可修改、不可删除 —— 路由层不提供编辑入口。
     *
     * @param  array<int, string>  $commentTexts
     * @param  array<int, UploadedFile>  $files
     */
    public function createGuidance(
        Project $project,
        User $advisor,
        ManuscriptVersion $version,
        string $summary,
        array $commentTexts,
        array $files = [],
        ?Booking $booking = null,
    ): GuidanceRecord {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($project, $advisor, $version, $summary, $commentTexts, $files, $booking) {
            if ($version->project_id !== $project->id) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'manuscript_version_id' => '指导记录必须针对本课题下的稿件版本。',
                ])->status(422);
            }

            $record = GuidanceRecord::create([
                'project_id' => $project->id,
                'booking_id' => $booking?->id,
                'advisor_id' => $advisor->id,
                'manuscript_version_id' => $version->id,
                'summary' => $summary,
            ]);

            foreach ($commentTexts as $text) {
                $record->comments()->create([
                    'advisor_id' => $advisor->id,
                    'content' => $text,
                    'status' => Comment::STATUS_OPEN,
                ]);
            }

            $this->storeAttachments($record, $files, $advisor);

            if ($booking && $booking->status === 'booked') {
                $booking->update(['status' => 'completed']);
                $booking->slot->update(['status' => 'done']);
            }

            $this->notifications->send(
                $project->student,
                'guidance_created',
                '导师留下了新的指导意见',
                sprintf('针对您的第 %d 版稿件《%s》，导师提出了 %d 条评语。', $version->version_no, $version->title, count($commentTexts)),
                ['project_id' => $project->id, 'guidance_record_id' => $record->id],
            );

            return $record->load(['comments', 'attachments', 'manuscriptVersion', 'booking']);
        });
    }

    /** 导师关闭评语（学生无权关闭）。可附确认说明。 */
    public function closeComment(Comment $comment, User $advisor, ?string $note = null): Comment
    {
        $record = $comment->guidanceRecord;
        if ($record->advisor_id !== $advisor->id) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['comment' => '只能关闭自己提出的评语。'])->status(403);
        }

        $comment->update([
            'status' => Comment::STATUS_CLOSED,
            'closed_by' => $advisor->id,
            'closed_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $project = $record->project;
        $this->notifications->send(
            $project->student,
            'comment_closed',
            '一条评语已被导师确认关闭',
            $note ?: sprintf('您对第 %d 版相关意见的修改已获导师确认。', $record->manuscriptVersion->version_no),
            ['comment_id' => $comment->id, 'project_id' => $project->id],
        );

        return $comment;
    }

    /** 导师对学生回应不满意，可把评语重新置为待处理 */
    public function reopenComment(Comment $comment, User $advisor): Comment
    {
        $record = $comment->guidanceRecord;
        if ($record->advisor_id !== $advisor->id) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['comment' => '只能操作自己提出的评语。'])->status(403);
        }

        $comment->update(['status' => Comment::STATUS_OPEN, 'closed_by' => null, 'closed_at' => null]);

        $this->notifications->send(
            $record->project->student,
            'comment_reopened',
            '导师要求继续修改一条意见',
            $comment->content,
            ['comment_id' => $comment->id, 'project_id' => $record->project_id],
        );

        return $comment;
    }

    /**
     * 导师依据“最终稿 + 未解决意见”确认答辩资格。
     * 存在未关闭意见时给出明确提示（导师可在确认知悉的情况下仍做决定，但必须显式 force）。
     */
    public function decideEligibility(Project $project, User $advisor, bool $eligible, ?string $note, bool $force = false): Project
    {
        if ($project->advisor_id !== $advisor->id) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['project' => '只有该课题的指导导师可以确认答辩资格。'])->status(403);
        }

        $finalVersion = $project->manuscriptVersions()->where('is_final', true)->where('status', 'active')->first();
        if ($eligible && !$finalVersion) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'defense_eligible' => '尚无学生提交的最终稿，不能确认具备答辩资格。',
            ])->status(422);
        }

        $openCount = $this->openCommentCount($project);
        if ($eligible && $openCount > 0 && !$force) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'defense_eligible' => "仍有 {$openCount} 条未关闭的指导意见；如确认资格请显式确认知悉（force=true）。",
                'open_comment_count' => $openCount,
            ])->status(422);
        }

        $project->update([
            'defense_eligible' => $eligible,
            'eligibility_note' => $note,
            'eligibility_decided_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $this->notifications->send(
            $project->student,
            'eligibility_decided',
            $eligible ? '导师确认您具备答辩资格' : '导师暂未确认答辩资格',
            $note ?: ($eligible
                ? '最终稿与修改意见已审核通过。'
                : '请根据最终稿与未解决的问题继续修改。'),
            ['project_id' => $project->id, 'defense_eligible' => $eligible],
        );

        return $project;
    }

    public function openCommentCount(Project $project): int
    {
        return Comment::query()
            ->whereHas('guidanceRecord', fn ($q) => $q->where('project_id', $project->id))
            ->where('status', '!=', Comment::STATUS_CLOSED)
            ->count();
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, UploadedFile>  $files
     */
    private function storeAttachments(object $attachable, array $files, User $uploader): void
    {
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            if (!$file instanceof UploadedFile) {
                continue;
            }

            $folder = $attachable instanceof ManuscriptVersion
                ? 'manuscripts'
                : 'guidance';

            $path = $file->store("attachments/{$folder}/{$attachable->id}", 'local');

            $attachable->attachments()->create([
                'path' => $path,
                'original_name' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                'mime' => $file->getClientMimeType(),
                'size' => $file->getSize(),
                'uploaded_by' => $uploader->id,
            ]);
        }
    }

    /** 附件本地磁盘读取（下载授权后使用） */
    public static function attachmentAbsolutePath(string $path): string
    {
        return Storage::disk('local')->path($path);
    }
}

            ->where('status', '!=', Comment::STATUS_CLOSED)
            ->count();
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, UploadedFile>  $files
     */
    private function storeAttachments(object $attachable, array $files, User $uploader): void
    {
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            if (!$file instanceof UploadedFile) {
                continue;
            }

            $folder = $attachable instanceof ManuscriptVersion
                ? 'manuscripts'
                : 'guidance';

            $path = $file->store("attachments/{$folder}/{$attachable->id}", 'local');

            $attachable->attachments()->create([
                'path' => $path,
                'original_name' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                'mime' => $file->getClientMimeType(),
                'size' => $file->getSize(),
                'uploaded_by' => $uploader->id,
            ]);
        }
    }

    /** 附件本地磁盘读取（下载授权后使用） */
    public static function attachmentAbsolutePath(string $path): string
    {
        return Storage::disk('local')->path($path);
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function login(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'email' => ['required', 'email'],
            'password' => ['required'],
        ]);

        if (!Auth::attempt($data)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => '邮箱或密码错误。',
            ])->status(401);
        }

        $user = Auth::user();
        $token = $user->createToken('spa')->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json([
            'token' => $token,
            'user' => [
                'id' => $user->id,
                'name' => $user->name,
                'email' => $user->email,
                'role' => $user->role,
                'student_no' => $user->student_no,
                'title' => $user->title,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function logout(Request $request)
    {
        $request->user()->currentAccessToken()->delete();

        return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
    }

    public function me(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        return response()->json([
            'id' => $user->id,

            'email' => $user->email,
            'role' => $user->role,
            'student_no' => $user->student_no,
            'title' => $user->title,
        ]);
    }
}

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(private ManuscriptService $manuscripts)
    {

    /**
     * 学生首页：突出“尚未处理（未关闭）的意见”，并聚合课题、稿件、预约。
     */
    public function student(Request $request)
    {
        $student = $request->user();

        $projects = Project::with([
            'advisor:id,name,title',
            'manuscriptVersions' => fn ($q) => $q->orderByDesc('version_no'),
        ])
            ->where('student_id', $student->id)
            ->get();

        $projectCards = $projects->map(function (Project $project) {
            $openComments = Comment::query()
                ->with(['guidanceRecord:id,manuscript_version_id,created_at', 'guidanceRecord.manuscriptVersion:id,version_no,title'])
                ->whereHas('guidanceRecord', fn ($q) => $q->where('project_id', $project->id))
                ->where('status', '!=', Comment::STATUS_CLOSED)
                ->orderByRaw("CASE status WHEN 'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END")
                ->orderBy('created_at')
                ->get();

            return [
                'id' => $project->id,
                'title' => $project->title,
                'advisor' => $project->advisor ? [
                    'id' => $project->advisor->id,
                    'name' => $project->advisor->name,
                    'title' => $project->advisor->title,
                ] : null,
                'deadline_at' => $project->deadline_at?->toDateTimeString(),
                'defense_eligible' => $project->defense_eligible,
                'latest_version' => $project->manuscriptVersions->first()?->only('id', 'version_no', 'title', 'status', 'is_final', 'created_at'),
                'open_comment_count' => $openComments->count(),
                'open_comments' => $openComments,
            ];
        });

        // 学生的近期预约
        $bookings = Booking::with(['slot', 'project:id,title'])

            ->whereHas('slot', fn ($q) => $q->where('start_at', '>=', now()->subDays(7)))
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->get();

        return response()->json([
            'projects' => $projectCards,

            'upcoming_bookings' => $bookings,

    /**

        $projects = Project::with('student:id,name,student_no')
            ->where('advisor_id', $advisor->id)
            ->get();

        $projectIds = $projects->pluck('id');

        $upcomingBookings = Booking::with(['slot', 'student:id,name,student_no', 'project:id,title'])

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Services\BookingService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class SlotController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(private BookingService $bookings)
    {
    }

    /** 导师创建开放时段（可批量） */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'start_at' => ['required', 'date', 'after:now'],
            'end_at' => ['required', 'date', 'after:start_at'],
        ], [], [
            'start_at' => '开始时间',
            'end_at' => '结束时间',
        ]);

        $advisor = $request->user();

        $slot = AdvisorSlot::create([
            'advisor_id' => $advisor->id,
            'start_at' => $data['start_at'],
            'end_at' => $data['end_at'],
            'status' => 'open',
        ]);

        return response()->json($slot, 201);
    }

    /** 学生：浏览导师的可预约时段 */
    public function openSlots(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'advisor_id' => ['required', 'integer', 'exists:users,id'],
        ]);

        $slots = AdvisorSlot::where('advisor_id', $request->advisor_id)
            ->where('status', 'open')
            ->where('start_at', '>', now())
            ->orderBy('start_at')
            ->get();

        return response()->json($slots);
    }

    /** 导师：查看自己的时段与预约情况 */
    public function mine(Request $request)
    {
        $slots = AdvisorSlot::with(['booking.student:id,name,student_no', 'booking.project:id,title'])
            ->where('advisor_id', $request->user()->id)
            ->orderBy('start_at')
            ->get();

        return response()->json($slots);
    }

    /** 导师请假：释放该时段，已预约学生被通知改约 */
    public function leave(Request $request, AdvisorSlot $slot)
    {
        $this->authorize('manage', $slot);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'reason' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
        ]);

        $slot = $this->bookings->advisorLeave($slot, $data['reason'] ?? null);

        return response()->json([
            'slot' => $slot->load(['booking.student:id,name,student_no']),
            'message' => '时段已标记为请假并释放。',
        ]);
    }

    /** 导师重新开放一个请假/已结束的空时段 */
    public function reopen(Request $request, AdvisorSlot $slot)
    {
        $this->authorize('manage', $slot);

        if ($slot->booking()->where('status', 'booked')->exists()) {
            abort(422, '该时段仍有有效预约，不能开放。');
        }

        $slot->update(['status' => 'open']);

        return response()->json($slot);
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

{
    public function __construct(private BookingService $bookings)
    {
    }

    /** 学生选择导师时段并提交讨论问题 */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'slot_id' => ['required', 'integer', 'exists:advisor_slots,id'],
            'project_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'exists:projects,id'],
            'questions' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
        ]);

        $student = $request->user();
        $slot = AdvisorSlot::findOrFail($data['slot_id']);
        $project = !empty($data['project_id']) ? Project::find($data['project_id']) : null;

        if ($project) {
            $this->authorize('view', $project);
        }

        $booking = $this->bookings->book($slot, $student, $project, $data['questions'] ?? null);

        return response()->json($booking, 201);
    }

    public function show(Request $request, Booking $booking)
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $booking);

        return response()->json($booking->load(['slot', 'student:id,name,student_no', 'project', 'guidanceRecord']));
    }

    /** 学生取消预约，时段释放 */
    public function destroy(Request $request, Booking $booking)
    {
        $this->authorize('cancel', $booking);

        $this->bookings->cancelByStudent($booking);

        return response()->json(['message' => '预约已取消，时段已重新开放。']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class ProjectController extends Controller
{
    /** 列表：学生看自己的课题；导师看自己指导的课题 */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $query = Project::with(['student:id,name,student_no', 'advisor:id,name,title']);

        if ($user->isStudent()) {
            $query->where('student_id', $user->id);
        } else {
            $query->where('advisor_id', $user->id);
        }

        return response()->json($query->orderByDesc('created_at')->get());
    }

    /**
     * 课题详情：版本时间线 + 不可变指导记录，用于追溯每次指导针对哪一版。
     */
    public function show(Request $request, Project $project)
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $project);

        $project->load([
            'student:id,name,student_no',
            'advisor:id,name,title',
            'manuscriptVersions.attachments',
            'manuscriptVersions.responses' => fn ($q) => $q->with('comment:id,guidance_record_id,content,status'),
            'bookings.slot',
            'guidanceRecords.advisor:id,name,title',
            'guidanceRecords.manuscriptVersion:id,version_no,title,status',
            'guidanceRecords.comments.responses.student:id,name',
            'guidanceRecords.attachments',
        ]);

        return response()->json($project);
    }

    /** 学生创建课题并选定导师 */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'title' => ['required', 'string', 'max:200'],
            'description' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
            'advisor_id' => ['required', 'integer', Rule::exists('users', 'id')->where('role', 'advisor')],
            'deadline_at' => ['nullable', 'date', 'after:now'],
        ]);

        $project = Project::create([
            'title' => $data['title'],
            'description' => $data['description'] ?? null,
            'student_id' => $request->user()->id,
            'advisor_id' => $data['advisor_id'],
            'deadline_at' => $data['deadline_at'] ?? null,
        ]);

        $advisor = User::find($data['advisor_id']);
        app(\App\Services\NotificationService::class)->send(
            $advisor,
            'project_created',
            '新的毕业设计课题',
            sprintf('%s 选择您作为《%s》的指导导师。', $request->user()->name, $data['title']),
            ['project_id' => $project->id],
        );

        return response()->json($project, 201);
    }

    /** 导师设置提交截止日（导师首页待办排序依据） */
    public function setDeadline(Request $request, Project $project)
    {
        $this->authorize('giveGuidance', $project);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'deadline_at' => ['required', 'date', 'after:now'],
        ]);

        $project->update(['deadline_at' => $data['deadline_at']]);

        app(\App\Services\NotificationService::class)->send(
            $project->student,
            'deadline_set',
            '导师设置了提交截止日',
            sprintf('《%s》提交截止：%s', $project->title, $project->fresh()->deadline_at->toDateTimeString()),
            ['project_id' => $project->id],
        );

        return response()->json($project->fresh());
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Services\ManuscriptService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ManuscriptController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(private ManuscriptService $manuscripts)
    {
    }

    /**
     * 学生上传新稿（multipart/form-data）。
     * files[] 附件；responses[comment_id] / responses[content] 为对旧评语的逐条回应。
     */
    public function store(Request $request, Project $project)
    {
        $this->authorize('submitManuscript', $project);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'title' => ['required', 'string', 'max:200'],
            'note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
            'booking_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'exists:bookings,id'],
            'is_final' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
            'files' => ['required'],
            'files.*' => ['file', 'max: 20480'],
            'responses' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'responses.*.comment_id' => ['required_with:responses', 'integer'],
            'responses.*.content' => ['required_with:responses', 'string', 'max:2000'],
        ]);

        $booking = null;
        if (!empty($data['booking_id'])) {
            $booking = Booking::findOrFail($data['booking_id']);
            if ($booking->student_id !== $request->user()->id) {
                abort(403, '只能关联自己的预约。');
            }
        }

        $version = $this->manuscripts->submitVersion(
            project: $project,
            student: $request->user(),
            title: $data['title'],
            note: $data['note'] ?? null,
            files: $request->file('files', []),
            responses: $data['responses'] ?? [],
            booking: $booking,
            isFinal: (bool) ($data['is_final'] ?? false),
        );

        return response()->json($version->load('attachments'), 201);
    }

    /** 单版本详情：附件、指导记录、所回应的评语 —— 版本追溯核心 */
    public function show(Request $request, ManuscriptVersion $version)
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $version->project);

        $version->load([
            'attachments',
            'student:id,name,student_no',
            'booking.slot',
            'guidanceRecords' => fn ($q) => $q->with(['advisor:id,name,title', 'comments.responses']),
            'responses.comment.guidanceRecord:id,manuscript_version_id',
        ]);

        return response()->json($version);
    }

    /** 学生撤回误传稿件（已被指导记录引用则拒绝） */
    public function withdraw(Request $request, ManuscriptVersion $version)
    {
        $this->authorize('submitManuscript', $version->project);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500'],
        ]);

        $updated = $this->manuscripts->withdrawVersion($version, $data['reason']);

        return response()->json([
            'version' => $updated,
            'message' => '稿件已撤回（历史行保留）。',
        ]);
    }
}

        return response()->json($comment);
    }
}

{
    public function __construct(private ManuscriptService $manuscripts)

    /**
     * 导师根据最终稿与未解决问题确认答辩资格。
     * 学生无权调用（策略 decideEligibility 仅允许课题导师）。

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Attachment;
use App\Services\ManuscriptService;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class AttachmentController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * 附件下载：策略确保仅课题学生与其导师可访问，其他导师 403。
     * 文件物理保存在本地 storage/app/attachments 目录。
     */
    public function download(Attachment $attachment): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('download', $attachment);

        $absolute = ManuscriptService::attachmentAbsolutePath($attachment->path);

        abort_unless(is_file($absolute), 404, '附件文件不存在（可能已被清理）。');

        return response()->download($absolute, $attachment->original_name, [
            'Content-Type' => $attachment->mime ?: 'application/octet-stream',
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\AppNotification;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class NotificationController extends Controller
{
    /** 本地模拟通知列表（前端轮询） */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $notifications = AppNotification::where('user_id', $request->user()->id)
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->limit(50)
            ->get();

        return response()->json([
            'notifications' => $notifications,
            'unread_count' => AppNotification::where('user_id', $request->user()->id)->whereNull('read_at')->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function markRead(Request $request, AppNotification $notification)
    {
        abort_unless($notification->user_id === $request->user()->id, 403);

        $notification->update(['read_at' => now()]);

        return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
    }

    public function markAllRead(Request $request)
    {
        AppNotification::where('user_id', $request->user()->id)
            ->whereNull('read_at')
            ->update(['read_at' => now()]);

        return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
    }
}

class EnsureUserHasRole
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, string ...$roles): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if (!$user || !in_array($user->role, $roles, true)) {
            abort(403, '当前角色无权执行该操作。');
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\BookingService;
use App\Services\ManuscriptService;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Http\Testing\File as TestingFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class DemoSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        Storage::fake('local');

        // 两名导师、两名学生（密码均为 password）
        $advisorWang = User::create(['name' => '王雅琴', 'email' => 'wang@example.edu', 'password' => 'password', 'role' => 'advisor', 'title' => '教授']);
        $advisorLi = User::create(['name' => '李国栋', 'email' => 'li@example.edu', 'password' => 'password', 'role' => 'advisor', 'title' => '副教授']);
        $studentZhang = User::create(['name' => '张一鸣', 'email' => 'zhang@example.edu', 'password' => 'password', 'role' => 'student', 'student_no' => '2021001']);
        $studentChen = User::create(['name' => '陈思琪', 'email' => 'chen@example.edu', 'password' => 'password', 'role' => 'student', 'student_no' => '2021002']);

        $bookingService = app(BookingService::class);
        $manuscriptService = app(ManuscriptService::class);

        // 张一鸣 的课题：导师王雅琴
        $project = Project::create([
            'title' => '基于联邦学习的校园能耗预测系统',
            'description' => '研究多校园数据不出域条件下的能耗联合建模。',
            'student_id' => $studentZhang->id,
            'advisor_id' => $advisorWang->id,
            'deadline_at' => now()->addDays(10),
        ]);

        // 王雅琴开放若干时段
        $slotA = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisorWang->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDay()->setTime(10, 0), 'end_at' => now()->addDay()->setTime(11, 0), 'status' => 'open']);
        $slotB = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisorWang->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDays(3)->setTime(14, 0), 'end_at' => now()->addDays(3)->setTime(15, 0), 'status' => 'open']);
        $slotC = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisorWang->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDays(5)->setTime(9, 0), 'end_at' => now()->addDays(5)->setTime(10, 0), 'status' => 'open']);
        // 李国栋的开放时段（用于跨导师访问演示）
        AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisorLi->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDays(2)->setTime(16, 0), 'end_at' => now()->addDays(2)->setTime(17, 0), 'status' => 'open']);

        // 张一鸣 预约 slotA
        $booking = $bookingService->book($slotA, $studentZhang, $project, '联邦聚合时客户端掉线如何处理？特征维度不一致怎么办？');

        // 提交 v1
        $v1File = TestingFile::createWithContent('thesis-v1.docx', '第1版：引言与系统设计初稿');
        $v1 = $manuscriptService->submitVersion($project, $studentZhang, '毕业论文 v1', '初稿，请老师重点看研究问题定义。', [$v1File], [], $booking);

        // 导师约谈后针对 v1 留下指导记录与两条评语，booking 完成
        $annotFile = TestingFile::createWithContent('批注-v1.pdf', '导师批注：研究问题需进一步聚焦');
        $record1 = $manuscriptService->createGuidance(
            $project,
            $advisorWang,
            $v1,
            '整体方向可行，但研究问题过大，实验设计缺少基线。',
            [
                '研究问题需要收敛到“掉线鲁棒性”这一个点，删掉无关章节。',
                '实验部分补充与 FedAvg、FedProx 的对比基线。',
            ],
            [$annotFile],
            $booking,
        );

        // 张一鸣 提交 v2，逐条回应两条评语（一条暂不回应，保留 open 演示未处理意见）
        $v2File = TestingFile::createWithContent('thesis-v2.docx', '第2版：收敛研究问题，补实验基线');
        $v2 = $manuscriptService->submitVersion(
            $project,
            $studentZhang,
            '毕业论文 v2',
            '已按上次意见修改，实验基线仍在跑。',
            [$v2File],
            [
                ['comment_id' => $record1->comments[0]->id, 'content' => '已将研究问题收敛为客户端掉线场景，删除了原第3章。'],
            ],
        );

        // 导师确认第 1 条已修改到位 → 关闭；第 2 条仍 open（学生首页突出显示）
        $manuscriptService->closeComment($record1->comments[0], $advisorWang, '收敛后的问题表述清晰，同意关闭。');

        // 陈思琪 的课题：导师李国栋（跨导师隔离演示）
        Project::create([
            'title' => '低轨卫星网络路由协议仿真',
            'description' => '面向星地链路频繁切换的路由策略。',
            'student_id' => $studentChen->id,
            'advisor_id' => $advisorLi->id,
            'deadline_at' => now()->addDays(20),
        ]);

        $this->command->info('演示数据已创建：');
        $this->command->table(
            ['角色', '姓名', '登录邮箱', '密码'],
            [
                ['学生', '张一鸣', 'zhang@example.edu', 'password'],
                ['学生', '陈思琪', 'chen@example.edu', 'password'],
                ['导师', '王雅琴', 'wang@example.edu', 'password'],
                ['导师', '李国栋', 'li@example.edu', 'password'],
            ]
        );
    }
}

Seeder uses Storage::fake which puts files in a temp dir that gets cleaned up. 

Storage::fake swaps the local disk root for the entire process, and its stored path configuration will mismatch with real local storage, so I switch to using real local storage for demos to ensure file persistence.

I'll write test files to /tmp and construct UploadedFile manually.

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\AppNotification;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

/**
 * 本地模拟通知：落库（前端轮询 /api/notifications），
 * 同时追加写入 storage/logs/notifications.log，模拟“推送到用户”。
 */
class NotificationService
{
    public function send(User $user, string $type, string $title, ?string $body = null, array $data = []): AppNotification
    {
        $notification = AppNotification::create([
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'type' => $type,
            'title' => $title,
            'body' => $body,
            'data' => $data,
        ]);

        $line = sprintf(
            "[%s] -> 用户#%d(%s) [%s] %s%s",
            now()->toDateTimeString(),
            $user->id,
            $user->name,
            $type,
            $title,
            $body ? " | {$body}" : '',
        );

        // 模拟外部推送通道（本地仅写日志文件）
        Log::build([
            'driver' => 'single',
            'path' => Storage::path('logs/notifications.log'),
        ])->info($line, $data);

        return $notification;
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;
use Tests\TestCase;

class BookingConflictTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function makeWorld(): array
    {
        $advisor = User::create(['name' => '王导师', 'email' => 'a@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $s1 = User::create(['name' => '学生甲', 'email' => 's1@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $s2 = User::create(['name' => '学生乙', 'email' => 's2@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $project = Project::create(['title' => '课题', 'student_id' => $s1->id, 'advisor_id' => $advisor->id]);
        $slot = AdvisorSlot::create([
            'advisor_id' => $advisor->id,
            'start_at' => now()->addDay(),
            'end_at' => now()->addDay()->addHour(),
            'status' => 'open',
        ]);

        return [$advisor, $s1, $s2, $project, $slot];
    }

    public function test_同一时段只能由一名学生预约_第二名得到409(): void
    {
        [, $s1, $s2, $project, $slot] = $this->makeWorld();

        Sanctum::actingAs($s1);
        $this->postJson('/api/bookings', ['slot_id' => $slot->id, 'project_id' => $project->id, 'questions' => '问题一'])
            ->assertCreated()
            ->assertJsonPath('status', 'booked');

        // 时段状态变为 booked
        $this->assertSame('booked', $slot->fresh()->status);

        // 学生乙抢同一时段 → 409
        Sanctum::actingAs($s2);
        $this->postJson('/api/bookings', ['slot_id' => $slot->id])
            ->assertStatus(409);

        // 数据库中该时段只有一条有效预约
        $this->assertSame(1, \App\Models\Booking::where('slot_id', $slot->id)->where('status', 'booked')->count());
    }

    public function test_学生取消后时段释放_其他学生可再约(): void
    {
        [, $s1, $s2, $project, $slot] = $this->makeWorld();

        Sanctum::actingAs($s1);
        $bookingId = $this->postJson('/api/bookings', ['slot_id' => $slot->id, 'project_id' => $project->id])
            ->assertCreated()->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($s1);
        $this->deleteJson("/api/bookings/{$bookingId}")->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame('open', $slot->fresh()->status);

        Sanctum::actingAs($s2);
        $this->postJson('/api/bookings', ['slot_id' => $slot->id])
            ->assertCreated()
            ->assertJsonPath('status', 'booked');
    }

    public function test_导师请假后释放时段并通知已预约学生(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $s1, , $project, $slot] = $this->makeWorld();

        Sanctum::actingAs($s1);
        $bookingId = $this->postJson('/api/bookings', ['slot_id' => $slot->id, 'project_id' => $project->id])
            ->assertCreated()->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->postJson("/api/slots/{$slot->id}/leave", ['reason' => '出差'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('slot.status', 'leave');

        $this->assertSame('cancelled', \App\Models\Booking::find($bookingId)->status);

        // 学生收到本地模拟通知
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('app_notifications', [
            'user_id' => $s1->id,
            'type' => 'slot_released_leave',
        ]);

        // 请假后的时段不能再被学生预约
        Sanctum::actingAs(User::create(['name' => '丙', 'email' => 's3@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']));
        $this->postJson('/api/bookings', ['slot_id' => $slot->id])->assertStatus(409);
    }

    public function test_不能预约自己课题以外的项目(): void
    {
        [, , $s2, $project, $slot] = $this->makeWorld();

        Sanctum::actingAs($s2);
        // 学生乙把别人的课题挂在预约上 → 403
        $this->postJson('/api/bookings', ['slot_id' => $slot->id, 'project_id' => $project->id])
            ->assertStatus(403);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Comment;
use App\Models\GuidanceRecord;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ManuscriptVersioningTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function world(): array
    {
        Storage::fake('local');
        $advisor = User::create(['name' => '王导师', 'email' => 'a@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $student = User::create(['name' => '张学生', 'email' => 's@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $project = Project::create(['title' => '课题', 'student_id' => $student->id, 'advisor_id' => $advisor->id]);

        return [$advisor, $student, $project];
    }

    private function upload(User $student, Project $project, string $versionName, array $extra = []): array
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $payload = array_merge([
            'title' => $versionName,
            'note' => "{$versionName} 说明",
            'files' => [UploadedFile::fake()->create("{$versionName}.docx", 20)],
        ], $extra);

        return $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/manuscripts", $payload, [
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_稿件版本号自增且旧稿全部保留(): void
    {
        [, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 1);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 2);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 3);

        $this->assertSame(3, ManuscriptVersion::where('project_id', $project->id)->count());
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v1.docx']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v3.docx']);
    }

    public function test_指导记录精确绑定到被指导的版本_新稿不改变历史指向(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');
        $v2Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->json('id');

        // 导师约谈后针对 v1 留评语（即使 v2 已存在，记录仍指向 v1）
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '针对 v1 的总体意见',
            'comments' => ['请补充文献综述', '图3不清晰'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertCreated();

        $record = GuidanceRecord::first();
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $record->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame(2, $record->comments()->count());

        // 学生提交 v3 并逐条回应
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $c1 = Comment::where('content', '请补充文献综述')->first();
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3', [
            'responses' => [
                ['comment_id' => $c1->id, 'content' => '已补充近三年12篇文献。'],
            ],
        ])->assertCreated();

        // 回应挂在 v3 上，评语变为 resolved；指导记录仍指向 v1（版本可追溯）
        $this->assertSame($v3Id, $c1->responses()->first()->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame('resolved', $c1->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, GuidanceRecord::first()->manuscript_version_id);

        // 课题详情时间线完整呈现
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $timeline = $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$project->id}")->json();
        $this->assertCount(3, $timeline['manuscript_versions']);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $timeline['guidance_records'][0]['manuscript_version']['id']);
    }

    public function test_未被引用的误传稿件可以撤回(): void
    {
        [, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1 = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/manuscripts/{$v1}/withdraw", ['reason' => '传错文件了'], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame('withdrawn', ManuscriptVersion::find($v1)->status);
        // 撤回不删除行，附件记录仍在
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('manuscript_versions', ['id' => $v1, 'status' => 'withdrawn']);
    }

    public function test_已被指导记录引用的稿件不能撤回(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '已约谈',
            'comments' => ['一条意见'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertCreated();

        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/manuscripts/{$v1Id}/withdraw", ['reason' => '想撤回'], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertStatus(422);

        $this->assertSame('active', ManuscriptVersion::find($v1Id)->status);

        // 指导记录没有编辑/删除入口：路由表中不存在 update/destroy
        $this->assertFalse(
            collect(app('router')->getRoutes())->contains(function ($route) {
                return str_contains($route->getName() ?: '', 'guidance') === false
                    && str_contains(serialize($route->action), 'GuidanceController')
                    && in_array('PUT', $route->methods, true) || false;
            })
        );
    }

    public function test_学生无权关闭评语_只有导师可以(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $record = $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '约谈',
            'comments' => ['需要修改'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->json('id');

        $commentId = Comment::where('guidance_record_id', $record)->first()->id;

        // 学生尝试关闭 → 403
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/comments/{$commentId}/close", ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame('open', Comment::find($commentId)->status);

        // 导师关闭成功
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/comments/{$commentId}/close")->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('status', 'closed');
    }

    public function test_导师依据最终稿与未关闭意见确认答辩资格(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $recordId = $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '约谈',
            'comments' => ['待修改'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->json('id');

        // 没有最终稿 → 不能确认资格
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true,
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertStatus(422);

        // 提交最终稿
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'final', ['is_final' => true])->assertCreated();

        // 有未关闭意见 → 拒绝并提示数量
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true,
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertStatus(422)->assertJsonPath('open_comment_count', 1);

        // 学生无权确认资格
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true, 'force' => true,
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertStatus(403);

        // 导师知悉未决意见后 force 确认
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true,
            'force' => true,
            'note' => '剩余问题为格式微调，不影响答辩。',
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('project.defense_eligible', true);
    }
}
