        $advisor = User::create(['name' => '王导师', 'email' => 'a@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $student = User::create(['name' => '张学生', 'email' => 's@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $project = Project::create(['title' => '课题', 'student_id' => $student->id, 'advisor_id' => $advisor->id]);

        return [$advisor, $student, $project];
    }

    private function upload(User $student, Project $project, string $versionName, array $extra = []): array
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $payload = array_merge([
            'title' => $versionName,
            'note' => "{$versionName} 说明",
            'files' => [UploadedFile::fake()->create("{$versionName}.docx", 20)],
        ], $extra);

        return $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/manuscripts", $payload, [
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_稿件版本号自增且旧稿全部保留(): void
    {
        [, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 1);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 2);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 3);

        $this->assertSame(3, ManuscriptVersion::where('project_id', $project->id)->count());
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v1.docx']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v3.docx']);
    }

    public function test_指导记录精确绑定到被指导的版本_新稿不改变历史指向(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');
        $v2Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->json('id');

        // 导师约谈后针对 v1 留评语（即使 v2 已存在，记录仍指向 v1）
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '针对 v1 的总体意见',
            'comments' => ['请补充文献综述', '图3不清晰'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertCreated();

        $record = GuidanceRecord::first();
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $record->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame(2, $record->comments()->count());

        // 学生提交 v3 并逐条回应
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $c1 = Comment::where('content', '请补充文献综述')->first();
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3', [
            'responses' => [
                ['comment_id' => $c1->id, 'content' => '已补充近三年12篇文献。'],
            ],
        ])->assertCreated();

        // 回应挂在 v3 上，评语变为 resolved；指导记录仍指向 v1（版本可追溯）
        $this->assertSame($v3Id, $c1->responses()->first()->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame('resolved', $c1->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, GuidanceRecord::first()->manuscript_version_id);

        // 课题详情时间线完整呈现
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $timeline = $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$project->id}")->json();
        $this->assertCount(3, $timeline['manuscript_versions']);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $timeline['guidance_records'][0]['manuscript_version']['id']);
    }

    public function test_未被引用的误传稿件可以撤回(): void
    {
        [, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1 = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/manuscripts/{$v1}/withdraw", ['reason' => '传错文件了'], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame('withdrawn', ManuscriptVersion::find($v1)->status);
        // 撤回不删除行，附件记录仍在
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('manuscript_versions', ['id' => $v1, 'status' => 'withdrawn']);
    }

    public function test_已被指导记录引用的稿件不能撤回(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '已约谈',
            'comments' => ['一条意见'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertCreated();

        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/manuscripts/{$v1Id}/withdraw", ['reason' => '想撤回'], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertStatus(422);

        $this->assertSame('active', ManuscriptVersion::find($v1Id)->status);

        // 指导记录没有编辑/删除入口：路由表中不存在 update/destroy
        $this->assertFalse(
            collect(app('router')->getRoutes())->contains(function ($route) {
                return str_contains($route->getName() ?: '', 'guidance') === false
                    && str_contains(serialize($route->action), 'GuidanceController')
                    && in_array('PUT', $route->methods, true) || false;
            })
        );
    }

    public function test_学生无权关闭评语_只有导师可以(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $record = $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '约谈',
            'comments' => ['需要修改'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->json('id');

        $commentId = Comment::where('guidance_record_id', $record)->first()->id;

        // 学生尝试关闭 → 403
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/comments/{$commentId}/close", ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame('open', Comment::find($commentId)->status);

        // 导师关闭成功
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/comments/{$commentId}/close")->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('status', 'closed');
    }

    public function test_导师依据最终稿与未关闭意见确认答辩资格(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $recordId = $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '约谈',
            'comments' => ['待修改'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->json('id');

        // 没有最终稿 → 不能确认资格
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true,
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertStatus(422);

        // 提交最终稿
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'final', ['is_final' => true])->assertCreated();

        // 有未关闭意见 → 拒绝并提示数量
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true,
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertStatus(422)->assertJsonPath('open_comment_count', 1);

        // 学生无权确认资格
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true, 'force' => true,
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertStatus(403);

        // 导师知悉未决意见后 force 确认
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true,
            'force' => true,
            'note' => '剩余问题为格式微调，不影响答辩。',
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('project.defense_eligible', true);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Models\Attachment;
use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Comment;
use App\Models\GuidanceRecord;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;
use Tests\TestCase;

class CrossAdvisorAccessTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private array $world;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Storage::fake('local');

        // 导师 A + 学生甲（课题 P1）；导师 B + 学生乙（课题 P2）
        $wang = User::create(['name' => '王导师', 'email' => 'wang@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $li = User::create(['name' => '李导师', 'email' => 'li@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $zhang = User::create(['name' => '张学生', 'email' => 'zhang@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $chen = User::create(['name' => '陈学生', 'email' => 'chen@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);

        $p1 = Project::create(['title' => '王-张 课题', 'student_id' => $zhang->id, 'advisor_id' => $wang->id]);
        $p2 = Project::create(['title' => '李-陈 课题', 'student_id' => $chen->id, 'advisor_id' => $li->id]);

        $slot = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $wang->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDay(), 'end_at' => now()->addDay()->addHour(), 'status' => 'open']);
        $booking = Booking::create(['slot_id' => $slot->id, 'student_id' => $zhang->id, 'project_id' => $p1->id, 'status' => 'booked']);
        $slot->update(['status' => 'booked']);

        $version = ManuscriptVersion::create([
            'project_id' => $p1->id, 'student_id' => $zhang->id, 'booking_id' => $booking->id,
            'version_no' => 1, 'title' => 'v1', 'status' => 'active',
        ]);
        $attachment = Attachment::create([
            'attachable_type' => ManuscriptVersion::class, 'attachable_id' => $version->id,
            'path' => 'attachments/manuscripts/1/v1.docx', 'original_name' => 'v1.docx',
            'mime' => 'application/octet-stream', 'size' => 10, 'uploaded_by' => $zhang->id,
        ]);
        $record = GuidanceRecord::create([
            'project_id' => $p1->id, 'booking_id' => $booking->id, 'advisor_id' => $wang->id,
            'manuscript_version_id' => $version->id, 'summary' => '王导师的指导',
        ]);
        $comment = Comment::create([
            'guidance_record_id' => $record->id, 'advisor_id' => $wang->id,
            'content' => '王导师的评语', 'status' => 'open',
        ]);

        $this->world = compact('wang', 'li', 'zhang', 'chen', 'p1', 'p2', 'slot', 'booking', 'version', 'attachment', 'record', 'comment');
    }

    public static function forbiddenEndpoints(): array
    {
        return [
            '课题详情' => ['get', '/api/projects/%d', 'p1'],
            '稿件版本' => ['get', '/api/manuscripts/%d', 'version'],
            '指导记录' => ['get', '/api/projects/%d/guidance/%d', ['p1', 'record']],
        ];

    /**

            ->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能给别人的课题写指导记录(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->postJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $this->world['version']->id,
            'summary' => '越权指导',
            'comments' => ['不该出现'],
        ])->assertStatus(403);

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('guidance_records', ['summary' => '越权指导']);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能关闭别人课题的评语(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->postJson("/api/comments/{$this->world['comment']->id}/close")
            ->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame('open', $this->world['comment']->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能确认别人课题的答辩资格(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->postJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true, 'force' => true,
        ])->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertNull($this->world['p1']->fresh()->defense_eligible);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能对别人的时段请假或查看预约(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);

        $this->postJson("/api/slots/{$this->world['slot']->id}/leave")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame('booked', $this->world['slot']->fresh()->status);

        $this->getJson("/api/bookings/{$this->world['booking']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_其他学生不能查看别人的课题与稿件(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['chen']);

        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->getJson("/api/manuscripts/{$this->world['version']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_未登录请求被拦截401(): void
    {
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertStatus(401);
    }

    public function test_课题学生与本人导师可以正常访问(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['zhang']);
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertOk();

        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['wang']);
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertOk();
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")->assertOk();
    }

    private function resolveIds(string $key, string $template): array
    {
        // 指导记录需要 project + record 两个 id
        if (str_contains($template, 'guidance')) {
            return [$this->world['p1']->id, $this->world['record']->id];
        }

        return [$this->world[$key]->id];
    }
}

    }

    private function resolveIds(string $key, string $template): array
    {
        // 指导记录需要 project + record 两个 id
        if (str_contains($template, 'guidance')) {
            return [$this->world['p1']->id, $this->world['record']->id];
        }

        return [$this->world[$key]->id];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Models\Attachment;
use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Comment;
use App\Models\GuidanceRecord;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;
use Tests\TestCase;

class CrossAdvisorAccessTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private array $world;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Storage::fake('local');

        // 导师 A + 学生甲（课题 P1）；导师 B + 学生乙（课题 P2）
        $wang = User::create(['name' => '王导师', 'email' => 'wang@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $li = User::create(['name' => '李导师', 'email' => 'li@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $zhang = User::create(['name' => '张学生', 'email' => 'zhang@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $chen = User::create(['name' => '陈学生', 'email' => 'chen@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);

        $p1 = Project::create(['title' => '王-张 课题', 'student_id' => $zhang->id, 'advisor_id' => $wang->id]);
        $p2 = Project::create(['title' => '李-陈 课题', 'student_id' => $chen->id, 'advisor_id' => $li->id]);

        $slot = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $wang->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDay(), 'end_at' => now()->addDay()->addHour(), 'status' => 'open']);
        $booking = Booking::create(['slot_id' => $slot->id, 'student_id' => $zhang->id, 'project_id' => $p1->id, 'status' => 'booked']);
        $slot->update(['status' => 'booked']);

        $version = ManuscriptVersion::create([
            'project_id' => $p1->id, 'student_id' => $zhang->id, 'booking_id' => $booking->id,
            'version_no' => 1, 'title' => 'v1', 'status' => 'active',
        ]);
        $attachment = Attachment::create([
            'attachable_type' => ManuscriptVersion::class, 'attachable_id' => $version->id,
            'path' => 'attachments/manuscripts/1/v1.docx', 'original_name' => 'v1.docx',
            'mime' => 'application/octet-stream', 'size' => 10, 'uploaded_by' => $zhang->id,
        ]);
        $record = GuidanceRecord::create([
            'project_id' => $p1->id, 'booking_id' => $booking->id, 'advisor_id' => $wang->id,
            'manuscript_version_id' => $version->id, 'summary' => '王导师的指导',
        ]);
        $comment = Comment::create([
            'guidance_record_id' => $record->id, 'advisor_id' => $wang->id,
            'content' => '王导师的评语', 'status' => 'open',
        ]);

        $this->world = compact('wang', 'li', 'zhang', 'chen', 'p1', 'p2', 'slot', 'booking', 'version', 'attachment', 'record', 'comment');
    }

    public static function forbiddenEndpoints(): array
    {
        return [
            '课题详情' => ['get', '/api/projects/%d', 'p1'],
            '稿件版本' => ['get', '/api/manuscripts/%d', 'version'],
            '指导记录' => ['get', '/api/projects/%d/guidance/%d', ['p1', 'record']],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider forbiddenEndpoints
     */
    public function test_其他导师无法查看不属于自己的资料(string $method, string $template, string $key): void
    {
        $li = $this->world['li'];
        Sanctum::actingAs($li);

        $ids = $this->resolveIds($key, $template);
        $url = vsprintf($template, $ids);

        $this->{$method . 'Json'}($url)->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_其他导师下载附件被拒(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")
            ->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能给别人的课题写指导记录(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->postJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $this->world['version']->id,
            'summary' => '越权指导',
            'comments' => ['不该出现'],
        ])->assertStatus(403);

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('guidance_records', ['summary' => '越权指导']);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能关闭别人课题的评语(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->postJson("/api/comments/{$this->world['comment']->id}/close")
            ->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame('open', $this->world['comment']->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能确认别人课题的答辩资格(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->postJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true, 'force' => true,
        ])->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertNull($this->world['p1']->fresh()->defense_eligible);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能对别人的时段请假或查看预约(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);

        $this->postJson("/api/slots/{$this->world['slot']->id}/leave")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame('booked', $this->world['slot']->fresh()->status);

        $this->getJson("/api/bookings/{$this->world['booking']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_其他学生不能查看别人的课题与稿件(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['chen']);

        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->getJson("/api/manuscripts/{$this->world['version']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_未登录请求被拦截401(): void
    {
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertStatus(401);
    }

    public function test_课题学生与本人导师可以正常访问(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['zhang']);
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertOk();

        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['wang']);
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertOk();
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")->assertOk();
    }

    private function resolveIds(string $key, string $template): array
    {
        // 指导记录需要 project + record 两个 id
        if (str_contains($template, 'guidance')) {
            return [$this->world['p1']->id, $this->world['record']->id];
        }

        return [$this->world[$key]->id];
    }
}

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;

class AdvisorSlot extends Model

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'start_at' => 'datetime',
            'end_at' => 'datetime',
        ];

    public function advisor(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'advisor_id');
    }

    public function booking(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(Booking::class);
    }

    public function isBookable(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === 'open';
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Attachment;
use App\Services\ManuscriptService;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class AttachmentController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * 附件下载：策略确保仅课题学生与其导师可访问，其他导师 403。
     * 文件物理保存在本地 storage/app/attachments 目录。
     */
    public function download(Attachment $attachment): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('download', $attachment);

        $absolute = ManuscriptService::attachmentAbsolutePath($attachment->path);

        abort_unless(is_file($absolute), 404, '附件文件不存在（可能已被清理）。');

        return response()->download($absolute, $attachment->original_name, [
            'Content-Type' => $attachment->mime ?: 'application/octet-stream',
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Comment;
use App\Models\GuidanceRecord;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ManuscriptVersioningTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function world(): array
    {
        Storage::fake('local');
        $advisor = User::create(['name' => '王导师', 'email' => 'a@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $student = User::create(['name' => '张学生', 'email' => 's@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $project = Project::create(['title' => '课题', 'student_id' => $student->id, 'advisor_id' => $advisor->id]);

        return [$advisor, $student, $project];
    }

    private function upload(User $student, Project $project, string $versionName, array $extra = []): array
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $payload = array_merge([
            'title' => $versionName,
            'note' => "{$versionName} 说明",
            'files' => [UploadedFile::fake()->create("{$versionName}.docx", 20)],
        ], $extra);

        return $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/manuscripts", $payload, [
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_稿件版本号自增且旧稿全部保留(): void
    {
        [, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 1);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 2);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 3);

        $this->assertSame(3, ManuscriptVersion::where('project_id', $project->id)->count());
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v1.docx']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v3.docx']);
    }

    public function test_指导记录精确绑定到被指导的版本_新稿不改变历史指向(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');
        $v2Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->json('id');

        // 导师约谈后针对 v1 留评语（即使 v2 已存在，记录仍指向 v1）
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '针对 v1 的总体意见',
            'comments' => ['请补充文献综述', '图3不清晰'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertCreated();

        $record = GuidanceRecord::first();
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $record->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame(2, $record->comments()->count());

        // 学生提交 v3 并逐条回应
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $c1 = Comment::where('content', '请补充文献综述')->first();
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3', [
            'responses' => [
                ['comment_id' => $c1->id, 'content' => '已补充近三年12篇文献。'],
            ],
        ])->assertCreated();

        // 回应挂在 v3 上，评语变为 resolved；指导记录仍指向 v1（版本可追溯）
        $this->assertSame($v3Id, $c1->responses()->first()->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame('resolved', $c1->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, GuidanceRecord::first()->manuscript_version_id);

        // 课题详情时间线完整呈现
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $timeline = $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$project->id}")->json();
        $this->assertCount(3, $timeline['manuscript_versions']);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $timeline['guidance_records'][0]['manuscript_version']['id']);
    }

    public function test_未被引用的误传稿件可以撤回(): void
    {
        [, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1 = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/manuscripts/{$v1}/withdraw", ['reason' => '传错文件了'], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame('withdrawn', ManuscriptVersion::find($v1)->status);
        // 撤回不删除行，附件记录仍在
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('manuscript_versions', ['id' => $v1, 'status' => 'withdrawn']);
    }

    public function test_已被指导记录引用的稿件不能撤回(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

use Tests\TestCase;

class CrossAdvisorAccessTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private array $world;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Storage::fake('local');

        // 导师 A + 学生甲（课题 P1）；导师 B + 学生乙（课题 P2）
        $wang = User::create(['name' => '王导师', 'email' => 'wang@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $li = User::create(['name' => '李导师', 'email' => 'li@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $zhang = User::create(['name' => '张学生', 'email' => 'zhang@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $chen = User::create(['name' => '陈学生', 'email' => 'chen@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);

        $p1 = Project::create(['title' => '王-张 课题', 'student_id' => $zhang->id, 'advisor_id' => $wang->id]);
        $p2 = Project::create(['title' => '李-陈 课题', 'student_id' => $chen->id, 'advisor_id' => $li->id]);

        $slot = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $wang->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDay(), 'end_at' => now()->addDay()->addHour(), 'status' => 'open']);
        $booking = Booking::create(['slot_id' => $slot->id, 'student_id' => $zhang->id, 'project_id' => $p1->id, 'status' => 'booked']);
        $slot->update(['status' => 'booked']);

        $version = ManuscriptVersion::create([
            'project_id' => $p1->id, 'student_id' => $zhang->id, 'booking_id' => $booking->id,
            'version_no' => 1, 'title' => 'v1', 'status' => 'active',
        ]);
        $attachment = Attachment::create([
            'attachable_type' => ManuscriptVersion::class, 'attachable_id' => $version->id,
            'path' => 'attachments/manuscripts/1/v1.docx', 'original_name' => 'v1.docx',
            'mime' => 'application/octet-stream', 'size' => 10, 'uploaded_by' => $zhang->id,
        ]);
        // 让物理文件真实存在（fake 磁盘），以便鉴权通过后下载成功
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage::disk('local')->put($attachment->path, '0123456789');
        $record = GuidanceRecord::create([
            'project_id' => $p1->id, 'booking_id' => $booking->id, 'advisor_id' => $wang->id,
            'manuscript_version_id' => $version->id, 'summary' => '王导师的指导',
        ]);
        $comment = Comment::create([
            'guidance_record_id' => $record->id, 'advisor_id' => $wang->id,
            'content' => '王导师的评语', 'status' => 'open',
        ]);

        $this->world = compact('wang', 'li', 'zhang', 'chen', 'p1', 'p2', 'slot', 'booking', 'version', 'attachment', 'record', 'comment');
    }

    public static function forbiddenEndpoints(): array
    {
        return [
            '课题详情' => ['get', '/api/projects/%d', 'p1'],
            '稿件版本' => ['get', '/api/manuscripts/%d', 'version'],
            '指导记录' => ['get', '/api/projects/%d/guidance/%d', ['p1', 'record']],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider forbiddenEndpoints
     */
    public function test_其他导师无法查看不属于自己的资料(string $method, string $template, string $key): void
    {
        $li = $this->world['li'];
        Sanctum::actingAs($li);

        $ids = $this->resolveIds($key, $template);
        $url = vsprintf($template, $ids);

        $this->{$method . 'Json'}($url)->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_其他导师下载附件被拒(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")
            ->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能给别人的课题写指导记录(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->postJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $this->world['version']->id,
            'summary' => '越权指导',
            'comments' => ['不该出现'],
        ])->assertStatus(403);

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('guidance_records', ['summary' => '越权指导']);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能关闭别人课题的评语(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->postJson("/api/comments/{$this->world['comment']->id}/close")
            ->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame('open', $this->world['comment']->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能确认别人课题的答辩资格(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);
        $this->postJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true, 'force' => true,
        ])->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertNull($this->world['p1']->fresh()->defense_eligible);
    }

    public function test_其他导师不能对别人的时段请假或查看预约(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['li']);

        $this->postJson("/api/slots/{$this->world['slot']->id}/leave")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame('booked', $this->world['slot']->fresh()->status);

        $this->getJson("/api/bookings/{$this->world['booking']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_其他学生不能查看别人的课题与稿件(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['chen']);

        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->getJson("/api/manuscripts/{$this->world['version']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_未登录请求被拦截401(): void
    {
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertStatus(401);
    }

    public function test_课题学生与本人导师可以正常访问(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['zhang']);
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertOk();

        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['wang']);
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertOk();
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")->assertOk();
    }

    private function resolveIds(string $key, string $template): array
    {
        // 指导记录需要 project + record 两个 id
        if (str_contains($template, 'guidance')) {
            return [$this->world['p1']->id, $this->world['record']->id];
        }

        return [$this->world[$key]->id];
    }
}

    public function test_其他导师不能给别人的课题写指导记录(): void

        $this->assertSame('booked', $this->world['slot']->fresh()->status);

    }

    public function test_其他学生不能查看别人的课题与稿件(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['chen']);

        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->getJson("/api/manuscripts/{$this->world['version']->id}")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")->assertStatus(403);
    }

    public function test_未登录请求被拦截401(): void
    {
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertStatus(401);
    }

    public function test_课题学生与本人导师可以正常访问(): void
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['zhang']);
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertOk();

        Sanctum::actingAs($this->world['wang']);
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$this->world['p1']->id}")->assertOk();
        $this->getJson("/api/attachments/{$this->world['attachment']->id}/download")->assertOk();
    }

    private function resolveIds(string $key, string $template): array
    {
        // 指导记录需要 project + record 两个 id
        if (str_contains($template, 'guidance')) {
            return [$this->world['p1']->id, $this->world['record']->id];
        }

        return [$this->world[$key]->id];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Comment;
use App\Models\GuidanceRecord;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ManuscriptVersioningTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function world(): array
    {
        Storage::fake('local');
        $advisor = User::create(['name' => '王导师', 'email' => 'a@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $student = User::create(['name' => '张学生', 'email' => 's@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $project = Project::create(['title' => '课题', 'student_id' => $student->id, 'advisor_id' => $advisor->id]);

        return [$advisor, $student, $project];
    }

    private function upload(User $student, Project $project, string $versionName, array $extra = []): TestResponse
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $payload = array_merge([
            'title' => $versionName,
            'note' => "{$versionName} 说明",
            'files' => [UploadedFile::fake()->create("{$versionName}.docx", 20)],
        ], $extra);

        return $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/manuscripts", $payload, [
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_稿件版本号自增且旧稿全部保留(): void
    {
        [, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 1);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 2);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 3);

        $this->assertSame(3, ManuscriptVersion::where('project_id', $project->id)->count());
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v1.docx']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v3.docx']);
    }

    public function test_指导记录精确绑定到被指导的版本_新稿不改变历史指向(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');
        $v2Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->json('id');

        // 导师约谈后针对 v1 留评语（即使 v2 已存在，记录仍指向 v1）
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '针对 v1 的总体意见',
            'comments' => ['请补充文献综述', '图3不清晰'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertCreated();

        $record = GuidanceRecord::first();
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $record->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame(2, $record->comments()->count());

        // 学生提交 v3 并逐条回应
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $c1 = Comment::where('content', '请补充文献综述')->first();
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3', [
            'responses' => [
                ['comment_id' => $c1->id, 'content' => '已补充近三年12篇文献。'],
            ],
        ])->assertCreated();

        // 回应挂在 v3 上，评语变为 resolved；指导记录仍指向 v1（版本可追溯）
        $this->assertSame($v3Id, $c1->responses()->first()->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame('resolved', $c1->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, GuidanceRecord::first()->manuscript_version_id);

        // 课题详情时间线完整呈现
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $timeline = $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$project->id}")->json();
        $this->assertCount(3, $timeline['manuscript_versions']);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $timeline['guidance_records'][0]['manuscript_version']['id']);
    }

    public function test_未被引用的误传稿件可以撤回(): void
    {
        [, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1 = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/manuscripts/{$v1}/withdraw", ['reason' => '传错文件了'], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame('withdrawn', ManuscriptVersion::find($v1)->status);
        // 撤回不删除行，附件记录仍在
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('manuscript_versions', ['id' => $v1, 'status' => 'withdrawn']);
    }

    public function test_已被指导记录引用的稿件不能撤回(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '已约谈',
            'comments' => ['一条意见'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertCreated();

        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/manuscripts/{$v1Id}/withdraw", ['reason' => '想撤回'], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertStatus(422);

        $this->assertSame('active', ManuscriptVersion::find($v1Id)->status);

        // 指导记录没有编辑/删除入口：遍历路由，GuidanceController 只允许 POST(store)/GET(show)
        $methods = [];
        foreach (app('router')->getRoutes() as $route) {
            $controller = $route->getActionName();
            if (str_contains($controller, 'GuidanceController')) {
                $methods[] = implode(':', $route->methods) . '@' . class_basename(explode('@', $controller)[0] ?? '');
            }
        }
        $joined = implode(',', $methods);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('POST', $joined);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('PUT', $joined);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('PATCH', $joined);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('DELETE', $joined);
    }

    public function test_学生无权关闭评语_只有导师可以(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $record = $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '约谈',
            'comments' => ['需要修改'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->json('id');

        $commentId = Comment::where('guidance_record_id', $record)->first()->id;

        // 学生尝试关闭 → 403
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/comments/{$commentId}/close", ['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame('open', Comment::find($commentId)->status);

        // 导师关闭成功
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/comments/{$commentId}/close")->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('status', 'closed');
    }

    public function test_导师依据最终稿与未关闭意见确认答辩资格(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $recordId = $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '约谈',
            'comments' => ['待修改'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->json('id');

        // 没有最终稿 → 不能确认资格
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true,
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertStatus(422);

        // 提交最终稿
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'final', ['is_final' => true])->assertCreated();

        // 有未关闭意见 → 拒绝并提示数量
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true,
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertStatus(422)->assertJsonPath('open_comment_count', 1);

        // 学生无权确认资格
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true, 'force' => true,
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertStatus(403);

        // 导师知悉未决意见后 force 确认
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/eligibility", [
            'defense_eligible' => true,
            'force' => true,
            'note' => '剩余问题为格式微调，不影响答辩。',
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('project.defense_eligible', true);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Comment;

use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ManuscriptVersioningTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function world(): array
    {
        Storage::fake('local');
        $advisor = User::create(['name' => '王导师', 'email' => 'a@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $student = User::create(['name' => '张学生', 'email' => 's@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $project = Project::create(['title' => '课题', 'student_id' => $student->id, 'advisor_id' => $advisor->id]);

        return [$advisor, $student, $project];
    }

    private function upload(User $student, Project $project, string $versionName, array $extra = []): TestResponse
    {
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $payload = array_merge([
            'title' => $versionName,
            'note' => "{$versionName} 说明",
            'files' => [UploadedFile::fake()->create("{$versionName}.docx", 20)],
        ], $extra);

        return $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/manuscripts", $payload, [
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_稿件版本号自增且旧稿全部保留(): void
    {
        [, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 1);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 2);
        $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3')->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('version_no', 3);

        $this->assertSame(3, ManuscriptVersion::where('project_id', $project->id)->count());
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v1.docx']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('attachments', ['original_name' => 'v3.docx']);
    }

    public function test_指导记录精确绑定到被指导的版本_新稿不改变历史指向(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');
        $v2Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v2')->json('id');

        // 导师约谈后针对 v1 留评语（即使 v2 已存在，记录仍指向 v1）
        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->post("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $v1Id,
            'summary' => '针对 v1 的总体意见',
            'comments' => ['请补充文献综述', '图3不清晰'],
        ], ['Accept' => 'application/json'])->assertCreated();

        $record = GuidanceRecord::first();
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $record->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame(2, $record->comments()->count());

        // 学生提交 v3 并逐条回应
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $c1 = Comment::where('content', '请补充文献综述')->first();
        $v3Resp = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v3', [
            'responses' => [
                ['comment_id' => $c1->id, 'content' => '已补充近三年12篇文献。'],
            ],
        ]);
        $v3Resp->assertCreated();
        $v3Id = $v3Resp->json('id');

        // 回应挂在 v3 上，评语变为 resolved；指导记录仍指向 v1（版本可追溯）
        $this->assertSame($v3Id, $c1->responses()->first()->manuscript_version_id);
        $this->assertSame('resolved', $c1->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, GuidanceRecord::first()->manuscript_version_id);

        // 课题详情时间线完整呈现
        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $timeline = $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$project->id}")->json();
        $this->assertCount(3, $timeline['manuscript_versions']);
        $this->assertSame($v1Id, $timeline['guidance_records'][0]['manuscript_version']['id']);
    }

            if (str_contains($controller, 'GuidanceController')) {

            }
        }
        $joined = implode(',', $methods);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('POST', $joined);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('PUT', $joined);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('PATCH', $joined);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('DELETE', $joined);
    }

    public function test_学生无权关闭评语_只有导师可以(): void
    {
        [$advisor, $student, $project] = $this->world();

        $v1Id = $this->upload($student, $project, 'v1')->json('id');

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# 一键启动：毕业设计指导预约与评语版本系统
# 用法：
#   ./start.sh            首次安装依赖、迁移+演示数据，然后在 http://localhost:8000 启动
#   ./start.sh --fresh    清空数据库并重新填充演示数据后启动
#   ./start.sh --no-seed  不执行数据库初始化（保留现有数据）
#
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

PHP_BIN="${PHP_BIN:-}"
FRESH=0
NO_SEED=0
for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
        --fresh) FRESH=1 ;;
        --no-seed) NO_SEED=1 ;;
    esac
done

log() { printf '\033[36m[start]\033[0m %s\n' "$1"; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 确保 PHP 可用（无 root 时下载静态 PHP 到用户目录）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ensure_php() {
    if [ -n "$PHP_BIN" ] && [ -x "$PHP_BIN" ]; then return; fi
    if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1 && php -m | grep -q pdo_sqlite; then
        PHP_BIN="$(command -v php)"; return
    fi
    if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/php" ] && "$HOME/.local/bin/php" -m | grep -q pdo_sqlite; then
        PHP_BIN="$HOME/.local/bin/php"; return
    fi

    log "未找到带 pdo_sqlite 的 PHP，下载静态 PHP 到 ~/.local/bin …"
    mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
    local url="https://dl.static-php.dev/static-php-cli/common/php-8.3.20-cli-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
    curl -sSL --fail "$url" -o /tmp/static-php.tar.gz
    tar xzf /tmp/static-php.tar.gz -C /tmp
    mv /tmp/php "$HOME/.local/bin/php"
    chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/php"
    PHP_BIN="$HOME/.local/bin/php"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 确保 Composer 可用
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ensure_composer() {
    if command -v composer >/dev/null 2>&1; then COMPOSER="composer"; return; fi
    if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/composer" ]; then COMPOSER="$HOME/.local/bin/composer"; return; fi
    log "安装 Composer …"
    mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
    curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer | "$PHP_BIN" -- --install-dir="$HOME/.local/bin" --filename=composer
    COMPOSER="$HOME/.local/bin/composer"
}

ensure_php
ensure_composer
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
log "使用 PHP：$($PHP_BIN -r 'echo PHP_VERSION;')"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. PHP / Node 依赖
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ ! -d vendor ]; then
    log "安装 PHP 依赖（composer install）…"
    "$COMPOSER" install --no-interaction --prefer-dist
fi

if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then
    log "安装前端依赖（npm install）…"
    npm install
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 环境配置
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    log "从 .env.example 创建 .env …"
    cp .env.example .env
    # 切换到 SQLite
    sed -i 's/^DB_CONNECTION=.*/DB_CONNECTION=sqlite/' .env
    grep -q '^DB_DATABASE=' .env \
        && sed -i "s|^DB_DATABASE=.*|DB_DATABASE=$ROOT/database/database.sqlite|" .env \
        || echo "DB_DATABASE=$ROOT/database/database.sqlite" >> .env
fi

if ! grep -q '^APP_KEY=base64:' .env; then
    log "生成 APP_KEY …"
    "$PHP_BIN" artisan key:generate --force
fi

mkdir -p database storage/app/private storage/logs bootstrap/cache
touch database/database.sqlite
"$PHP_BIN" artisan storage:link >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. 前端构建
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "构建 React 前端 …"
npm run build

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. 数据库迁移与演示数据
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$NO_SEED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$FRESH" -eq 1 ]; then
        log "重置数据库并填充演示数据 …"
        "$PHP_BIN" artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force
    else
        "$PHP_BIN" artisan migrate --force
        # 仅在尚无用户时填充演示数据
        user_count="$("$PHP_BIN" artisan tinker --execute='echo \App\Models\User::count();' 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr -dc '0-9' || echo 0)"
        if [ "${user_count:-0}" = "0" ]; then
            log "填充演示数据 …"
            "$PHP_BIN" artisan db:seed --force
        fi
    fi
fi

"$PHP_BIN" artisan config:clear >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. 启动
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PORT="${PORT:-8000}"
log "启动完成：请在浏览器打开 http://localhost:${PORT}"
log "演示账号：zhang@example.edu / chen@example.edu / wang@example.edu / li@example.edu（密码均为 password）"
exec "$PHP_BIN" artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port="${PORT}"

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Comment;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Services\ManuscriptService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(private ManuscriptService $manuscripts)
    {
    }

    /**
     * 学生首页：突出“尚未处理（未关闭）的意见”，并聚合课题、稿件、预约。
     */
    public function student(Request $request)
    {
        $student = $request->user();

        $projects = Project::with([
            'advisor:id,name,title',
            'manuscriptVersions' => fn ($q) => $q->orderByDesc('version_no'),
        ])
            ->where('student_id', $student->id)
            ->get();

        $projectCards = $projects->map(function (Project $project) {
            $openComments = Comment::query()
                ->with(['guidanceRecord:id,manuscript_version_id,created_at', 'guidanceRecord.manuscriptVersion:id,version_no,title'])
                ->whereHas('guidanceRecord', fn ($q) => $q->where('project_id', $project->id))
                ->where('status', '!=', Comment::STATUS_CLOSED)
                ->orderByRaw("CASE status WHEN 'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END")
                ->orderBy('created_at')
                ->get();

            return [
                'id' => $project->id,
                'title' => $project->title,
                'advisor' => $project->advisor ? [
                    'id' => $project->advisor->id,
                    'name' => $project->advisor->name,
                    'title' => $project->advisor->title,
                ] : null,
                'deadline_at' => $project->deadline_at?->toDateTimeString(),
                'defense_eligible' => $project->defense_eligible,
                'latest_version' => $project->manuscriptVersions->first()?->only('id', 'version_no', 'title', 'status', 'is_final', 'created_at'),
                'open_comment_count' => $openComments->count(),
                'open_comments' => $openComments,
            ];
        });

        // 学生的近期预约
        $bookings = Booking::with(['slot', 'project:id,title'])
            ->where('student_id', $student->id)
            ->whereIn('status', ['booked', 'completed'])
            ->whereHas('slot', fn ($q) => $q->where('start_at', '>=', now()->subDays(7)))
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->get();

        return response()->json([
            'projects' => $projectCards,
            'total_open_comments' => $projectCards->sum('open_comment_count'),
            'upcoming_bookings' => $bookings,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * 导师首页待办：按预约时间与提交截止日排序。
     */
    public function advisor(Request $request)
    {
        $advisor = $request->user();

        $projects = Project::with('student:id,name,student_no')
            ->where('advisor_id', $advisor->id)
            ->get();

        $projectIds = $projects->pluck('id');

        // 待办 1：即将到来的有效预约（按预约时间升序）
        $upcomingBookings = Booking::with(['slot', 'student:id,name,student_no', 'project:id,title'])
            ->whereIn('project_id', $projectIds)
            ->where('status', 'booked')
            ->whereHas('slot', fn ($q) => $q->where('start_at', '>=', now()))
            ->join('advisor_slots', 'bookings.slot_id', '=', 'advisor_slots.id')
            ->orderBy('advisor_slots.start_at')
            ->select('bookings.*')
            ->get();

        // 待办 2：学生已回应、等待导师确认关闭的评语
        $pendingConfirmComments = Comment::with([
            'guidanceRecord:id,project_id,manuscript_version_id',
            'guidanceRecord.project:id,title,student_id',
            'guidanceRecord.project.student:id,name,student_no',
            'responses' => fn ($q) => $q->latest('created_at')->limit(1),
        ])
            ->where('advisor_id', $advisor->id)

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Comment;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;
use Tests\TestCase;

class DashboardTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_导师首页按预约时间升序返回待办且无歧义列错误(): void
    {
        $advisor = User::create(['name' => '导师', 'email' => 'a@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $student = User::create(['name' => '学生', 'email' => 's@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);

        $project = Project::create([
            'title' => '课题', 'student_id' => $student->id, 'advisor_id' => $advisor->id,
            'deadline_at' => now()->addDays(5),
        ]);

        // 两个未来预约，刻意乱序插入，期望返回按开始时间升序
        $later = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisor->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDays(3), 'end_at' => now()->addDays(3)->addHour(), 'status' => 'booked']);
        $sooner = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisor->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDay(), 'end_at' => now()->addDay()->addHour(), 'status' => 'booked']);
        Booking::create(['slot_id' => $later->id, 'student_id' => $student->id, 'project_id' => $project->id, 'status' => 'booked']);
        Booking::create(['slot_id' => $sooner->id, 'student_id' => $student->id, 'project_id' => $project->id, 'status' => 'booked']);

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $res = $this->getJson('/api/dashboard/advisor')->assertOk();

        $bookings = $res->json('upcoming_bookings');
        $this->assertCount(2, $bookings);
        // 更早的时段排前面
        $this->assertSame($sooner->id, $bookings[0]['slot_id']);
        $this->assertSame($later->id, $bookings[1]['slot_id']);
        // 未来截止日天数为正
        $this->assertSame(5, $res->json('deadlines.0.days_left'));
    }

    public function test_学生首页聚合未关闭意见数(): void
    {
        $advisor = User::create(['name' => '导师', 'email' => 'a@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        $student = User::create(['name' => '学生', 'email' => 's@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'student']);
        $project = Project::create(['title' => '课题', 'student_id' => $student->id, 'advisor_id' => $advisor->id]);
        $version = ManuscriptVersion::create([
            'project_id' => $project->id, 'student_id' => $student->id,
            'version_no' => 1, 'title' => 'v1', 'status' => 'active',
        ]);

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $this->postJson("/api/projects/{$project->id}/guidance", [
            'manuscript_version_id' => $version->id,
            'summary' => '约谈',
            'comments' => ['意见一', '意见二'],
        ])->assertCreated();

        Sanctum::actingAs($student);
        $res = $this->getJson('/api/dashboard/student')->assertOk();
        $this->assertSame(2, $res->json('total_open_comments'));

        // 一名其他导师看不到任何聚合数据（他名下无课题），更无法访问该课题
        $otherAdvisor = User::create(['name' => '别的导师', 'email' => 'b@e.com', 'password' => 'x', 'role' => 'advisor']);
        Sanctum::actingAs($otherAdvisor);
        $this->getJson("/api/projects/{$project->id}")->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->getJson('/api/dashboard/advisor')->json('counts.upcoming_bookings'));
    }
}

    {

        $project = Project::create([
            'title' => '课题', 'student_id' => $student->id, 'advisor_id' => $advisor->id,
            'deadline_at' => now()->addDays(5),
        ]);

        // 两个未来预约，刻意乱序插入，期望返回按开始时间升序
        $later = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisor->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDays(3), 'end_at' => now()->addDays(3)->addHour(), 'status' => 'booked']);
        $sooner = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisor->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDay(), 'end_at' => now()->addDay()->addHour(), 'status' => 'booked']);
        Booking::create(['slot_id' => $later->id, 'student_id' => $student->id, 'project_id' => $project->id, 'status' => 'booked']);
        Booking::create(['slot_id' => $sooner->id, 'student_id' => $student->id, 'project_id' => $project->id, 'status' => 'booked']);

        Sanctum::actingAs($advisor);
        $res = $this->getJson('/api/dashboard/advisor')->assertOk();

        $bookings = $res->json('upcoming_bookings');

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;
use App\Models\Booking;
use App\Models\Comment;
use App\Models\ManuscriptVersion;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Services\ManuscriptService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(private ManuscriptService $manuscripts)
    {
    }

    /**
     * 学生首页：突出“尚未处理（未关闭）的意见”，并聚合课题、稿件、预约。
     */
    public function student(Request $request)
    {
        $student = $request->user();

        $projects = Project::with([
            'advisor:id,name,title',
            'manuscriptVersions' => fn ($q) => $q->orderByDesc('version_no'),
        ])
            ->where('student_id', $student->id)
            ->get();

        $projectCards = $projects->map(function (Project $project) {
            $openComments = Comment::query()
                ->with(['guidanceRecord:id,manuscript_version_id,created_at', 'guidanceRecord.manuscriptVersion:id,version_no,title'])
                ->whereHas('guidanceRecord', fn ($q) => $q->where('project_id', $project->id))
                ->where('status', '!=', Comment::STATUS_CLOSED)
                ->orderByRaw("CASE status WHEN 'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END")
                ->orderBy('created_at')
                ->get();

            return [
                'id' => $project->id,
                'title' => $project->title,
                'advisor' => $project->advisor ? [
                    'id' => $project->advisor->id,
                    'name' => $project->advisor->name,
                    'title' => $project->advisor->title,
                ] : null,
                'deadline_at' => $project->deadline_at?->toDateTimeString(),
                'defense_eligible' => $project->defense_eligible,
                'latest_version' => $project->manuscriptVersions->first()?->only('id', 'version_no', 'title', 'status', 'is_final', 'created_at'),
                'open_comment_count' => $openComments->count(),
                'open_comments' => $openComments,
            ];
        });

        // 学生的近期预约
        $bookings = Booking::with(['slot', 'project:id,title'])
            ->where('student_id', $student->id)
            ->whereIn('status', ['booked', 'completed'])
            ->whereHas('slot', fn ($q) => $q->where('start_at', '>=', now()->subDays(7)))
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->get();

        return response()->json([
            'projects' => $projectCards,
            'total_open_comments' => $projectCards->sum('open_comment_count'),
            'upcoming_bookings' => $bookings,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * 导师首页待办：按预约时间与提交截止日排序。
     */
    public function advisor(Request $request)
    {
        $advisor = $request->user();

        $projects = Project::with('student:id,name,student_no')
            ->where('advisor_id', $advisor->id)
            ->get();

        $projectIds = $projects->pluck('id');

        // 待办 1：即将到来的有效预约（按预约时间升序）
        $upcomingBookings = Booking::with(['slot', 'student:id,name,student_no', 'project:id,title'])
            ->whereIn('bookings.project_id', $projectIds)
            ->where('bookings.status', 'booked')
            ->whereHas('slot', fn ($q) => $q->where('start_at', '>=', now()))
            ->join('advisor_slots', 'bookings.slot_id', '=', 'advisor_slots.id')
            ->orderBy('advisor_slots.start_at')
            ->select('bookings.*')
            ->get();

        // 待办 2：学生已回应、等待导师确认关闭的评语
        $pendingConfirmComments = Comment::with([
            'guidanceRecord:id,project_id,manuscript_version_id',
            'guidanceRecord.project:id,title,student_id',
            'guidanceRecord.project.student:id,name,student_no',
            'responses' => fn ($q) => $q->latest('created_at')->limit(1),
        ])
            ->where('advisor_id', $advisor->id)
            ->where('status', Comment::STATUS_RESOLVED)
            ->orderBy('updated_at')
            ->get();

        // 待办 3：临近截止日（按截止日升序）
        $deadlines = $projects
            ->filter(fn ($p) => $p->deadline_at && $p->deadline_at->isFuture())
            ->sortBy('deadline_at')
            ->map(fn ($p) => [
                'project_id' => $p->id,
                'title' => $p->title,
                'student' => $p->student?->only('id', 'name', 'student_no'),
                'deadline_at' => $p->deadline_at->toDateTimeString(),
                'days_left' => (int) now()->diffInDays($p->deadline_at, false),
            ])
            ->values();

        // 待办 4：等待资格确认（有最终稿但尚未决定）
        $finalPending = $projects->filter(function (Project $p) {
            return $p->defense_eligible === null
                && ManuscriptVersion::where('project_id', $p->id)->where('is_final', true)->where('status', 'active')->exists();
        })->map(fn ($p) => [
            'project_id' => $p->id,
            'title' => $p->title,
            'student' => $p->student?->only('id', 'name', 'student_no'),
            'open_comment_count' => $this->manuscripts->openCommentCount($p),
        ])->values();

        // 今日/本周开放与请假时段概览
        $slots = AdvisorSlot::where('advisor_id', $advisor->id)
            ->where('start_at', '>=', now()->startOfDay())
            ->where('start_at', '<=', now()->addDays(14))
            ->orderBy('start_at')
            ->get();

        return response()->json([
            'upcoming_bookings' => $upcomingBookings,
            'pending_confirm_comments' => $pendingConfirmComments,
            'deadlines' => $deadlines,
            'final_pending' => $finalPending,
            'slots' => $slots,
            'counts' => [
                'upcoming_bookings' => $upcomingBookings->count(),
                'pending_confirm_comments' => $pendingConfirmComments->count(),
                'deadlines' => $deadlines->count(),
                'final_pending' => $finalPending->count(),
            ],
        ]);
    }
}

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Models\AdvisorSlot;

use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;

class DemoSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        // 演示附件写入真实本地磁盘 storage/app/attachments
        $makeFile = function (string $name, string $content): UploadedFile {
            $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'demo_');
            file_put_contents($tmp, $content);
            // test=true：允许在非 HTTP 上下文中存储上传文件
            return new UploadedFile($tmp, $name, null, null, true);
        };

        // 两名导师、两名学生（密码均为 password）
        $advisorWang = User::create(['name' => '王雅琴', 'email' => 'wang@example.edu', 'password' => 'password', 'role' => 'advisor', 'title' => '教授']);
        $advisorLi = User::create(['name' => '李国栋', 'email' => 'li@example.edu', 'password' => 'password', 'role' => 'advisor', 'title' => '副教授']);
        $studentZhang = User::create(['name' => '张一鸣', 'email' => 'zhang@example.edu', 'password' => 'password', 'role' => 'student', 'student_no' => '2021001']);
        $studentChen = User::create(['name' => '陈思琪', 'email' => 'chen@example.edu', 'password' => 'password', 'role' => 'student', 'student_no' => '2021002']);

        $bookingService = app(BookingService::class);
        $manuscriptService = app(ManuscriptService::class);

        // 张一鸣 的课题：导师王雅琴
        $project = Project::create([
            'title' => '基于联邦学习的校园能耗预测系统',
            'description' => '研究多校园数据不出域条件下的能耗联合建模。',
            'student_id' => $studentZhang->id,
            'advisor_id' => $advisorWang->id,
            'deadline_at' => now()->addDays(10),
        ]);

        // 王雅琴开放若干时段
        $slotA = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisorWang->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDay()->setTime(10, 0), 'end_at' => now()->addDay()->setTime(11, 0), 'status' => 'open']);
        $slotB = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisorWang->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDays(3)->setTime(14, 0), 'end_at' => now()->addDays(3)->setTime(15, 0), 'status' => 'open']);
        $slotC = AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisorWang->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDays(5)->setTime(9, 0), 'end_at' => now()->addDays(5)->setTime(10, 0), 'status' => 'open']);
        // 李国栋的开放时段（用于跨导师访问演示）
        AdvisorSlot::create(['advisor_id' => $advisorLi->id, 'start_at' => now()->addDays(2)->setTime(16, 0), 'end_at' => now()->addDays(2)->setTime(17, 0), 'status' => 'open']);

        // 张一鸣 预约 slotA
        $booking = $bookingService->book($slotA, $studentZhang, $project, '联邦聚合时客户端掉线如何处理？特征维度不一致怎么办？');

        // 提交 v1
        $v1File = $makeFile('thesis-v1.docx', '第1版：引言与系统设计初稿');
        $v1 = $manuscriptService->submitVersion($project, $studentZhang, '毕业论文 v1', '初稿，请老师重点看研究问题定义。', [$v1File], [], $booking);

        // 导师约谈后针对 v1 留下指导记录与两条评语，booking 完成
        $annotFile = $makeFile('批注-v1.pdf', '导师批注：研究问题需进一步聚焦');
        $record1 = $manuscriptService->createGuidance(

            $v1,
            '整体方向可行，但研究问题过大，实验设计缺少基线。',
            [
                '研究问题需要收敛到“掉线鲁棒性”这一个点，删掉无关章节。',
                '实验部分补充与 FedAvg、FedProx 的对比基线。',
            ],
            [$annotFile],
            $booking,
        );

        // 张一鸣 提交 v2，逐条回应两条评语（一条暂不回应，保留 open 演示未处理意见）
        $v2File = $makeFile('thesis-v2.docx', '第2版：收敛研究问题，补实验基线');

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# 一键启动：毕业设计指导预约与评语版本系统
# 用法：
#   ./start.sh            首次安装依赖、迁移+演示数据，然后在 http://localhost:8000 启动
#   ./start.sh --fresh    清空数据库并重新填充演示数据后启动
#   ./start.sh --no-seed  不执行数据库初始化（保留现有数据）
#
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

PHP_BIN="${PHP_BIN:-}"
FRESH=0
NO_SEED=0
for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
        --fresh) FRESH=1 ;;
        --no-seed) NO_SEED=1 ;;
    esac
done

log() { printf '\033[36m[start]\033[0m %s\n' "$1"; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 确保 PHP 可用（无 root 时下载静态 PHP 到用户目录）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ensure_php() {
    if [ -n "$PHP_BIN" ] && [ -x "$PHP_BIN" ]; then return; fi
    if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1 && php -m | grep -q pdo_sqlite; then
        PHP_BIN="$(command -v php)"; return
    fi
    if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/php" ] && "$HOME/.local/bin/php" -m | grep -q pdo_sqlite; then
        PHP_BIN="$HOME/.local/bin/php"; return
    fi

    log "未找到带 pdo_sqlite 的 PHP，下载静态 PHP 到 ~/.local/bin …"
    mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
    local url="https://dl.static-php.dev/static-php-cli/common/php-8.3.20-cli-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
    curl -sSL --fail "$url" -o /tmp/static-php.tar.gz
    tar xzf /tmp/static-php.tar.gz -C /tmp
    mv /tmp/php "$HOME/.local/bin/php"
    chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/php"
    PHP_BIN="$HOME/.local/bin/php"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 确保 Composer 可用
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ensure_composer() {
    if command -v composer >/dev/null 2>&1; then COMPOSER="composer"; return; fi
    if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/composer" ]; then COMPOSER="$HOME/.local/bin/composer"; return; fi
    log "安装 Composer …"
    mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
    curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer | "$PHP_BIN" -- --install-dir="$HOME/.local/bin" --filename=composer
    COMPOSER="$HOME/.local/bin/composer"
}

ensure_php
ensure_composer
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

if [ ! -d vendor ]; then
    log "安装 PHP 依赖（composer install）…"
    "$COMPOSER" install --no-interaction --prefer-dist
fi

if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then
    log "安装前端依赖（npm install）…"
    npm install
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 环境配置

if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    log "从 .env.example 创建 .env …"
    cp .env.example .env
    # 切换到 SQLite
    sed -i 's/^DB_CONNECTION=.*/DB_CONNECTION=sqlite/' .env
    grep -q '^DB_DATABASE=' .env \
        && sed -i "s|^DB_DATABASE=.*|DB_DATABASE=$ROOT/database/database.sqlite|" .env \
        || echo "DB_DATABASE=$ROOT/database/database.sqlite" >> .env
fi

if ! grep -q '^APP_KEY=base64:' .env; then
    log "生成 APP_KEY …"
    "$PHP_BIN" artisan key:generate --force
fi

mkdir -p database storage/app/private storage/logs bootstrap/cache
touch database/database.sqlite
"$PHP_BIN" artisan storage:link >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. 前端构建
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "构建 React 前端 …"
npm run build

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. 数据库迁移与演示数据
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$NO_SEED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$FRESH" -eq 1 ]; then
        log "重置数据库并填充演示数据 …"
        "$PHP_BIN" artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force
    else
        "$PHP_BIN" artisan migrate --force

        if [ "${user_count:-0}" = "0" ]; then
            log "填充演示数据 …"
            "$PHP_BIN" artisan db:seed --force
        fi
    fi
fi

"$PHP_BIN" artisan config:clear >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. 启动
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PORT="${PORT:-8000}"
log "启动完成：请在浏览器打开 http://localhost:${PORT}"
log "演示账号：zhang@example.edu / chen@example.edu / wang@example.edu / li@example.edu（密码均为 password）"

input.content:
# 毕业设计指导预约与评语版本系统

高校毕业设计场景的**约谈预约 + 稿件版本 + 评语追溯**系统。学生预约导师时段、上传稿件、逐条回应修改意见；导师约谈后针对具体版本留评语、确认关闭、依据最终稿确认答辩资格。

- **后端**：PHP 8.3 / Laravel 13 / Eloquent / Sanctum token 鉴权
- **数据库**：SQLite（单文件，无需任何外部服务）
- **前端**：React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS（SPA，由 Laravel 提供页面）
- **通知**：本地模拟 —— 写库（站内 🔔 轮询）+ 追加 `storage/logs/notifications.log`
- **附件**：本地目录 `storage/app/private/attachments/`，旧稿附件永不删除
- **启动**：一条命令 `./start.sh`

## 快速开始

```bash
./start.sh          # 首次启动：自动装依赖、迁移、填充演示数据、构建前端并起服务
# 打开 http://localhost:8000
```

常用参数：

```bash
./start.sh --fresh    # 清空数据库、清理旧附件与通知日志，重新填充演示数据
./start.sh --no-seed  # 保留现有数据，只启动
PORT=8080 ./start.sh  # 换端口
```

> 脚本会自动检测 PHP/Composer；当前环境无 root 时，会下载内置 SQLite 扩展的静态 PHP 到 `~/.local/bin`。

### 演示账号（密码均为 `password`）

| 角色 | 姓名 | 邮箱 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 学生 | 张一鸣 | `zhang@example.edu` |
| 学生 | 陈思琪 | `chen@example.edu` |
| 导师 | 王雅琴 | `wang@example.edu` |
| 导师 | 李国栋 | `li@example.edu` |

张一鸣的课题已预置：v1 稿件 → 导师约谈评语 2 条 → v2 逐条回应（1 条已关闭、1 条仍待处理）→ 另有一场未来约谈。陈思琪/李国栋用于演示跨导师隔离。

## 业务规则落地位置

| 需求 | 实现 |
| --- | --- |
| 同一时段只能一人预约 | 事务 + 行锁校验，且 `bookings` 上有 SQLite 部分唯一索引 `(slot_id) WHERE status='booked'` 兜底并发（`BookingService::book`） |
| 导师请假释放时段 | `BookingService::advisorLeave`：预约取消、时段置 `leave`、向学生发改约通知 |
| 学生取消 | 时段回到 `open`，历史预约行保留（故部分唯一索引允许再次预约） |
| 每次指导能查清针对哪一版 | `guidance_records.manuscript_version_id` 外键绑定；项目详情按版本时间线展示，新建指导必须选择版本 |
| 旧稿/附件/评语全部保留 | 稿件只有新增版本（`version_no` 课题内自增），从不物理删除；附件随版本/记录保存 |
| 误传稿件可撤回 | 可将未被引用的版本标记 `withdrawn`；**一旦被指导记录引用则拒绝撤回（422）**（`ManuscriptVersion::canWithdraw`） |
| 指导记录不可改 | 只有创建/查看接口，**没有 update/delete 路由**；外键 `restrictOnDelete`；稿件撤回后记录原样指向该版本 |
| 学生交新稿逐条回应 | 上传时携带 `responses[comment_id,content]`，回应绑定到新版本，评语转 `resolved` 待导师确认 |
| 学生无权关闭意见 | 关闭/重开评语走 `CommentPolicy::manage`（仅提出意见的导师），学生调用 403 |
| 答辩资格仅导师确认 | `EligibilityController` + `ProjectPolicy::decideEligibility`；需有最终稿，有未关闭意见时拦截并要求显式 `force` |
| 防跨导师访问 | 所有资源经 Policy 鉴权，回溯到课题的 `student_id / advisor_id`；附件下载同样鉴权，其他导师/学生一律 403 |
| 学生首页突出未处理意见 | `GET /api/dashboard/student` 返回 `open_comments`（open 优先排序），首页顶部红/黄卡片 |
| 导师首页按时间排待办 | `GET /api/dashboard/advisor`：预约按开始时间升序、截止日按临近程度升序，另有待确认回应、待确认资格 |

## 版本与评语状态机

```
稿件版本：active ──学生撤回（且无指导记录引用）──> withdrawn

评语：    open ──学生在新稿回应──> resolved
            ▲                          │
            └────导师退回(reopen)──────┴────导师确认(close)──> closed
                                         （仅导师可 close/reopen）

答辩资格：null（未确认）──导师──> true / false   依据：最终稿 + 未关闭意见
```

## 主要 API（前缀 `/api`）

- `POST /auth/login` · `GET /auth/me` · `POST /auth/logout`
- `GET /dashboard/student` · `GET /dashboard/advisor`

# 毕业设计指导预约与评语版本系统

高校毕业设计场景的**约谈预约 + 稿件版本 + 评语追溯**系统。学生预约导师时段、上传稿件、逐条回应修改意见；导师约谈后针对具体版本留评语、确认关闭、依据最终稿确认答辩资格。

- **后端**：PHP 8.3 / Laravel 13 / Eloquent / Sanctum token 鉴权
- **数据库**：SQLite（单文件，无需任何外部服务）
- **前端**：React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS（SPA，由 Laravel 提供页面）
- **通知**：本地模拟 —— 写库（站内 🔔 轮询）+ 追加 `storage/logs/notifications.log`
- **附件**：本地目录 `storage/app/private/attachments/`，旧稿附件永不删除
- **启动**：一条命令 `./start.sh`

## 快速开始

```bash
./start.sh          # 首次启动：自动装依赖、迁移、填充演示数据、构建前端并起服务
# 打开 http://localhost:8000
```

常用参数：

```bash
./start.sh --fresh    # 清空数据库、清理旧附件与通知日志，重新填充演示数据
./start.sh --no-seed  # 保留现有数据，只启动
PORT=8080 ./start.sh  # 换端口
```

> 脚本会自动检测 PHP/Composer；当前环境无 root 时，会下载内置 SQLite 扩展的静态 PHP 到 `~/.local/bin`。

### 演示账号（密码均为 `password`）

| 角色 | 姓名 | 邮箱 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 学生 | 张一鸣 | `zhang@example.edu` |
| 学生 | 陈思琪 | `chen@example.edu` |
| 导师 | 王雅琴 | `wang@example.edu` |
| 导师 | 李国栋 | `li@example.edu` |

张一鸣的课题已预置：v1 稿件 → 导师约谈评语 2 条 → v2 逐条回应（1 条已关闭、1 条仍待处理）→ 另有一场未来约谈。陈思琪/李国栋用于演示跨导师隔离。

## 业务规则落地位置

| 需求 | 实现 |
| --- | --- |
| 同一时段只能一人预约 | 事务 + 行锁校验，且 `bookings` 上有 SQLite 部分唯一索引 `(slot_id) WHERE status='booked'` 兜底并发（`BookingService::book`） |
| 导师请假释放时段 | `BookingService::advisorLeave`：预约取消、时段置 `leave`、向学生发改约通知 |
| 学生取消 | 时段回到 `open`，历史预约行保留（故部分唯一索引允许再次预约） |
| 每次指导能查清针对哪一版 | `guidance_records.manuscript_version_id` 外键绑定；项目详情按版本时间线展示，新建指导必须选择版本 |
| 旧稿/附件/评语全部保留 | 稿件只有新增版本（`version_no` 课题内自增），从不物理删除；附件随版本/记录保存 |
| 误传稿件可撤回 | 可将未被引用的版本标记 `withdrawn`；**一旦被指导记录引用则拒绝撤回（422）**（`ManuscriptVersion::canWithdraw`） |
| 指导记录不可改 | 只有创建/查看接口，**没有 update/delete 路由**；外键 `restrictOnDelete`；稿件撤回后记录原样指向该版本 |
| 学生交新稿逐条回应 | 上传时携带 `responses[comment_id,content]`，回应绑定到新版本，评语转 `resolved` 待导师确认 |
| 学生无权关闭意见 | 关闭/重开评语走 `CommentPolicy::manage`（仅提出意见的导师），学生调用 403 |

```
            ▲                          │
            └────导师退回(reopen)──────┴────导师确认(close)──> closed
                                         （仅导师可 close/reopen）

答辩资格：null（未确认）──导师──> true / false   依据：最终稿 + 未关闭意见
```

- 资格：`POST /projects/{id}/eligibility`
- 附件：`GET /attachments/{id}/download`
- 通知：`GET /notifications` · `POST /notifications/{id}/read`

系统已完成并在 **http://localhost:8000** 运行中（`./start.sh` 启动的实例）。

## 完成情况

**技术栈**：PHP 8.3 + Laravel 13 + Eloquent + SQLite（单文件）+ React 18/Vite/Tailwind；本地模拟通知（站内 🔔 轮询 + `storage/logs/notifications.log`），附件存本地目录，`./start.sh` 一条命令完成装依赖、迁移、种子、构建与启动（无 root 时自动下载内置 SQLite 的静态 PHP）。

### 题目要求的三类示例，均有测试断言 + 实跑验证

**1. 预约冲突**（24 个测试全绿）
- 同一时段第二人预约 → **409**（事务行锁 + `bookings` 上 SQLite 部分唯一索引 `WHERE status='booked'` 双重兜底）
- 学生取消/导师请假 → 时段释放，历史预约行保留可再约；请假时学生收到改约通知

**2. 稿件与评语版本追溯**
- 演示课题：v1 投稿 → 导师约谈评语 2 条 → v2 逐条回应（1 条已关闭、1 条待处理）→ 最终稿 v3
- 指导记录外键精确绑定"针对哪一版"；已被引用的稿件撤回返回 **422**，未引用的误传稿可撤回（标记保留，记录指向不变）；指导记录只有创建/查看接口，无任何编辑/删除路由

**3. 跨导师访问**
- 李国栋访问王雅琴名下的课题/稿件/附件下载/写指导/关评语/确认资格/时段/预约，全部 **403**；学生互不可见；学生关闭评语、确认资格同样 403

### 双方首页
- **学生端**：顶部红/黄卡片突出未关闭意见（标注针对第几版），预约时段、上传新稿时对每条未决意见逐条回应（回应绑定到新版本）
- **导师端**：待办按预约时间、提交截止日排序，另有"待确认回应""待确认资格"；可开放/请假时段、针对选定版本写评语、关闭/退回意见、依据**最终稿+未关闭意见**确认答辩资格（有未决意见会拦截并要求显式确认知悉）

演示账号（密码均 `password`）：`zhang@example.edu`、`chen@example.edu`（学生），`wang@example.edu`、`li@example.edu`（导师）。

一个实现中发现并修复的真实 bug 值得一提：导师首页预约列表 JOIN 时段表后 `status` 列名歧义导致 500，已加表前缀限定并补了回归测试。

重置演示数据可运行 `./start.sh --fresh`；测试用 `php artisan test`。

lastPrompt: 我要做一个高校毕业设计指导预约与评语版本系统。学生和导师在这里安排约谈、提交稿件并跟进修改，双方需要能查清每次指导针对的是哪一版内容。  学生先选导师时段，上传稿件和准备讨论的问题。导师在约谈后针对该版本留下修改意见，学生交新稿时逐条回应，旧稿、附件和评语都要保留。学生首页突出尚未处理的意见，导师首页按预约时间和提交截止日安排待办。  同一时段只能由一名学生预约，导师请假后要释放相应时段。误传稿件…
